offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_eq :
  forall (A : Type) (m : addr -> A) (a : addr) (v : A),
    fun_updt m a v a = v.
Proof.
  intros A m a v.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec a a) as [_|H].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; apply H; reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_neq :
  forall (A : Type) (m : addr -> A) (a b : addr) (v : A),
    a <> b ->
    fun_updt m a v b = m b.
Proof.
  intros A m a b v Hneq.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec b a) as [Heq|Hne].
  - exfalso; apply Hneq; symmetry; exact Heq.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma decide_true_elim :
  forall (P : Prop) (A : Type) (x y : A),

  destruct (decide P) as [HP'|Hn].

  - exfalso; apply Hn; exact HP.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: extract_t9_from_a00_max_branch
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma extract_t9_from_a00_max_branch :
  forall (t_1 t_2 t_3 t_7 t_9 : addr -> R)
         (a_3 a_4 a_5 a_12 a_13 a_14 : addr)
         (r_11 : R)
         (m_4 : addr -> R)
         (r_2 r_6 r_15 : R),
    ~ Rlt 0 r_11 ->
    Rlt (t_2 a_3) (t_2 a_4) ->
    Rlt (t_3 a_5) (t_3 a_4) ->
    (if decide (Rlt 0 r_11)
     then t_9 = t_1
     else
       t_2 = t_1 /\
       (if decide (Rlt (t_2 a_3) (t_2 a_4))
        then
          t_3 = t_2 /\
          (if decide (Rlt (t_3 a_5) (t_3 a_4))
           then
             t_7 = t_3 /\
             Rmult 2 r_2 = r_6 /\
             fun_updt m_4 a_14 (Rdiv (Rplus (m_4 a_12) (m_4 a_13)) r_6) = t_9 /\
             Rle 0 r_2 /\
             Rle 0 r_15 /\
             is_finite32 r_2 /\
             is_finite32 r_15
           else True)
        else True)) ->
    fun_updt m_4 a_14 (Rdiv (Rplus (m_4 a_12) (m_4 a_13)) r_6) = t_9.
Proof.
  intros t_1 t_2 t_3 t_7 t_9 a_3 a_4 a_5 a_12 a_13 a_14 r_11 m_4 r_2 r_6 r_15
         Htrace Hcmp1 Hcmp2 Hbig.
  rewrite (decide_false_elim (Rlt 0 r_11) _ _ _ Htrace) in Hbig.
  destruct Hbig as [_ Hbig].
  rewrite (decide_true_elim (Rlt (t_2 a_3) (t_2 a_4)) _ _ _ Hcmp1) in Hbig.
  destruct Hbig as [_ Hbig].
  rewrite (decide_true_elim (Rlt (t_3 a_5) (t_3 a_4)) _ _ _ Hcmp2) in Hbig.
  destruct Hbig as [_ [_ [Hupd _]]].
  exact Hupd.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_shadow
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_shadow :
  forall (A : Type) (m : addr -> A) (p : addr) (v1 v2 : A),
    fun_updt (fun_updt m p v1) p v2 = fun_updt m p v2.
Proof.
  intros A m p v1 v2.
  apply mem_ext; intro q.
  destruct (classic (q = p)) as [->|Hneq].
  - repeat rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
  - rewrite fun_updt_neq by (intro Hp; apply Hneq; now symmetry).
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by (intro Hp; apply Hneq; now symmetry).
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by (intro Hp; apply Hneq; now symmetry).
    reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma upd_eq :
  forall (A B : Type) (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (f : A -> B) (x : A) (v : B),
    upd eq_dec f x v x = v.
Proof.
  intros A B eq_dec f x v.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (eq_dec x x) as [_|Hneq].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; apply Hneq; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma upd_neq :
  forall (A B : Type) (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (f : A -> B) (x y : A) (v : B),
    y <> x ->
    upd eq_dec f x v y = f y.
Proof.
  intros A B eq_dec f x y v Hneq.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (eq_dec y x) as [Heq|Hne].
  - exfalso; apply Hneq; exact Heq.
  - reflexivity.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_shadow

Lemma upd_shadow :
  forall (A B : Type) (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (f : A -> B) (x : A) (v1 v2 : B),
    upd eq_dec (upd eq_dec f x v1) x v2 = upd eq_dec f x v2.
Proof.
  intros A B eq_dec f x v1 v2.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro y.
  destruct (eq_dec y x) as [Heq|Hneq].
  - subst y. rewrite !upd_eq. reflexivity.
  - rewrite !upd_neq by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_shadow

Lemma upd_shadow :
  forall (A : Type) (addr_eq_dec : forall x y : addr, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (m : addr -> A) (p : addr) (v1 v2 : A),
    upd addr_eq_dec (upd addr_eq_dec m p v1) p v2 =
    upd addr_eq_dec m p v2.
Proof.
  intros A addr_eq_dec m p v1 v2.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro q.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec q p) as [->|Hqp].
  - destruct (addr_eq_dec p p) as [_|H]; [reflexivity|exfalso; auto].

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma upd_comm :
  forall (A : Type) (addr_eq_dec : forall x y : addr, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (m : addr -> A) (p1 p2 : addr) (v1 v2 : A),
    p1 <> p2 ->
    upd addr_eq_dec (upd addr_eq_dec m p1 v1) p2 v2 =
    upd addr_eq_dec (upd addr_eq_dec m p2 v2) p1 v1.
Proof.
  intros A addr_eq_dec m p1 p2 v1 v2 H12.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro q.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec q p2) as [Hq2|Hq2].
  - subst q.
    destruct (addr_eq_dec p2 p2) as [_|H]; [|exfalso; auto].
    destruct (addr_eq_dec p2 p1) as [Hp|_].
    + exfalso; apply H12; symmetry; exact Hp.
    + destruct (addr_eq_dec p2 p1) as [Hp'|_].
      * exfalso; apply H12; symmetry; exact Hp'.
      * reflexivity.
  - destruct (addr_eq_dec q p1) as [Hq1|Hq1].
    + subst q.
      destruct (addr_eq_dec p1 p2) as [Hp|_].
      * exfalso; apply H12; exact Hp.
      * destruct (addr_eq_dec p1 p1) as [_|H]; [|exfalso; auto].
        destruct (addr_eq_dec p1 p1) as [_|H']; [|exfalso; auto].
        reflexivity.
    + destruct (addr_eq_dec q p1) as [H|_]; [exfalso; auto|].
      destruct (addr_eq_dec q p2) as [H|_]; [exfalso; auto|].
      reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_eq :
  forall (f : addr -> R) (x : addr) (v : R),
    fun_updt f x v x = v.
Proof.
  intros; apply fun_updt_same.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_neq :
  forall (f : addr -> R) (x y : addr) (v : R),
    x <> y ->
    fun_updt f x v y = f y.
Proof.
  intros; apply fun_updt_other; assumption.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_ext
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_ext :
  forall (f g : addr -> R),
    (forall a : addr, f a = g a) ->
    f = g.
Proof.
  intros f g H.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro a; apply H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_shadow
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_shadow :
  forall (f : addr -> R) (x : addr) (v1 v2 : R),
    fun_updt (fun_updt f x v1) x v2 = fun_updt f x v2.
Proof.
  intros f x v1 v2.
  apply fun_updt_ext; intro a.
  destruct (classic (a = x)) as [->|Hneq].
  - repeat rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
  - assert (Hxna : x <> a) by (intro Heq; apply Hneq; symmetry; exact Heq).
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hxna.  (* outer update *)
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hxna.  (* inner update *)
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hxna.  (* RHS update *)
    reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_comm :
  forall (f : addr -> R) (x y : addr) (vx vy : R),
    x <> y ->
    fun_updt (fun_updt f x vx) y vy = fun_updt (fun_updt f y vy) x vx.
Proof.
  intros f x y vx vy Hxy.
  apply fun_updt_ext; intro a.
  destruct (classic (a = x)) as [->|Hax].
  - rewrite fun_updt_neq by (intro Heq; apply Hxy; symmetry; exact Heq).
    repeat rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
  - destruct (classic (a = y)) as [->|Hay].
    + rewrite fun_updt_eq.
      rewrite fun_updt_neq by (intro Heq; apply Hxy; exact Heq).
      rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
    + repeat rewrite fun_updt_neq by congruence. reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: shift_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma shift_neq :
  forall (p : addr) (i j : Z),
    i <> j ->
    shift p i <> shift p j.
Proof.
  intros p i j Hij Heq.
  apply Hij.
  apply shift_inj with (p := p).
  exact Heq.
Qed.

Lemma eqs10_equiv :
  forall (A : Type), Equivalence (@eqs10_realrmat_s A).
Proof.
  intro A.
  split.
  - exact (eqs10_refl A).
  - exact (eqs10_sym A).
  - exact (eqs10_trans A).
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: eqs10_transpose_cancel
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma eqs10_transpose_cancel :
  forall (A : Type) (x y : A),
    eqs10_realrmat_s (l_transpose x) (l_transpose y) ->
    eqs10_realrmat_s x y.
Proof.
  intros A x y H.
  pose proof (eqs10_congr_transpose A _ _ H) as H'.
  rewrite (l_transpose_involutive A x) in H'.
  rewrite (l_transpose_involutive A y) in H'.
  exact H'.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_idem_at
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_idem_at :
  forall (m : addr -> addr) (p : addr),
    fun_updt m p (m p) = m.
Proof.
  intros m p.
  apply functional_extensionality.
  intro q.
  destruct (classic (q = p)) as [->|Hneq].
  - rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
  - rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hneq. reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_commute_distinct
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_commute_distinct :
  forall (m : addr -> addr) (p1 p2 : addr) (v1 v2 : addr),
    p1 <> p2 ->
    fun_updt (fun_updt m p1 v1) p2 v2 =
    fun_updt (fun_updt m p2 v2) p1 v1.
Proof.
  intros m p1 p2 v1 v2 H12.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro q.
  destruct (classic (q = p1)) as [Hq1|Hq1].
  - subst q.
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact H12.
    rewrite fun_updt_eq.
    rewrite fun_updt_eq.
    reflexivity.
  - destruct (classic (q = p2)) as [Hq2|Hq2].
    + subst q.
      rewrite fun_updt_eq.
      rewrite fun_updt_neq by (intro Heq; apply H12; symmetry; exact Heq).
      rewrite fun_updt_eq.
      reflexivity.
    + rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hq2.
      rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hq1.
      rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hq1.
      rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hq2.
      reflexivity.
Qed.

  eapply p_linked_n_ext_on_range; [| exact Hlnk ].
  intros k Hk.

Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: shift_i3_outside_range_starting_at_2_plus_i3
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma shift_i3_outside_range_starting_at_2_plus_i3 :
  forall (base : addr) (len : Z) (i3 : Z),
    (forall x y : Z, x <> y -> shift base x <> shift base y) ->
    0 <= len ->
    (forall k : Z, 0 <= k < len -> shift base (2 + i3 + k) <> shift base i3).
Proof.
  intros base len i3 Hinj _ k Hk.
  apply Hinj.
  (* Avoid lia "Cannot find witness" by doing the arithmetic explicitly. *)

  assert (0 <= k) as Hk0 by lia.

offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma separated_from_pairwise_hyp :
  forall (t3 : addr -> addr) (a4 : addr) (i1 x i3 i4 : Z),
    (forall (i7 i6 : Z),
        i7 <> i6 ->
        i1 <= i6 ->
        i1 <= i7 ->
        i6 < x ->
        i7 < x ->
        separated (t3 (shift a4 i7)) 4 (t3 (shift a4 i6)) 4) ->
    i4 <> i3 ->
    i1 <= i3 ->
    i1 <= i4 ->
    2 + i3 <= x ->
    2 + i4 <= x ->
    separated (t3 (shift a4 i4)) 4 (t3 (shift a4 i3)) 4.
Proof.
  intros t3 a4 i1 x i3 i4 Hpair Hneq Hi3 Hi4 Hx3 Hx4.
  assert (Hi3lt : i3 < x) by (eapply lt_of_add2_le; eauto).
  assert (Hi4lt : i4 < x) by (eapply lt_of_add2_le; eauto).
  eapply Hpair; eauto.

  intros a5 t3 a4 i3 i4 Heq3 Heq4 Hsep.
  eapply separated_transport_both.
  - symmetry; exact Heq4.
  - symmetry; exact Heq3.
  - exact Hsep.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros m1 m2 base lo hi Hag k Hk.

    agree_on_shift_range m2 m3 base lo hi ->
    agree_on_shift_range m1 m3 base lo hi.
Proof.
  intros m1 m2 m3 base lo hi H12 H23 k Hk.
  specialize (H12 k Hk). specialize (H23 k Hk).
  now rewrite H12, H23.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: agree_on_shift_range_fun_updt_addr_outside
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma agree_on_shift_range_fun_updt_addr_outside :
  forall (m : addr -> addr) (base : addr) (upd lo hi : Z) (v : addr),
    (upd < lo \/ hi <= upd) ->
    agree_on_shift_range (fun_updt_addr m (shift base upd) v) m base lo hi.
Proof.
  intros m base upd lo hi v Hout k Hk.
  unfold fun_updt_addr.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec (shift base k) (shift base upd)) as [Heq|Hneq].
  - assert (k = upd) by (apply shift_inj with (b := base); exact Heq).
    subst k.
    destruct Hout as [Hlt|Hge]; lia.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: p_linked_n_preserved_by_update_after_prefix
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma p_linked_n_preserved_by_update_after_prefix :
  forall (t : Z -> Z) (m : addr -> addr)
         (root array_base : addr) (i_2 i_3 : Z) (le v : addr),
    0 <= i_3 ->
    p_linked_n t m root array_base i_2 i_3 le ->
    p_linked_n t (fun_updt_addr m (shift array_base (1 + i_2 + i_3)) v)
               root array_base i_2 i_3 le.
Proof.
  intros t m root array_base i_2 i_3 le v Hi3 Hln.
  eapply p_linked_n_ext_on_prefix with (m1 := m).
  - exact Hi3.
  - (* agreement on [i_2, i_2+i_3) because update index is >= i_2+i_3 *)
    apply agree_on_shift_range_sym.
    apply agree_on_shift_range_fun_updt_addr_outside.
    right.
    lia.
  - exact Hln.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros t a6 a2 a4 a3 i1 i2 H.
  eapply p_linked_n_fun_updt_head.

    0 <= j < (1 + i2) ->
    shift a4 (i1 + 1 + j) <> shift a4 i1.
Proof.
  intros a4 i1 i2 j Hj.
  apply shift_neq_of_Zneq.
  lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: p_linked_n_update_outside_succ_segment
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma p_linked_n_update_outside_succ_segment :
  forall (t : Z -> Z) (a6 : addr -> addr) (a2 a4 a3 : addr) (i1 i2 : Z) (v : addr),
    p_linked_n t a6 a2 a4 (i1 + 1) (1 + i2) a3 ->
    p_linked_n t (fun_updt a6 (shift a4 i1) v) a2 a4 (i1 + 1) (1 + i2) a3.
Proof.
  intros t a6 a2 a4 a3 i1 i2 v Hlinked.
  eapply p_linked_n_fun_updt_outside.
  - intros j Hj.
    replace ((i1 + 1) + j) with (i1 + 1 + j) by lia.
    (* Provide i2 explicitly to avoid unification issues. *)
    apply (shift_outside_succ_segment a4 i1 i2 j); assumption.
  - exact Hlinked.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: p_linked_n_fold_from_tail_at_x5
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma p_linked_n_fold_from_tail_at_x5 :
  forall (t : Z -> Z) (m : addr -> addr) (a8 a4 a3 : addr) (i_1 i_2 i_3 : Z),
    0 <= i_3 ->
    (2 + i_1 + i_2) = (1 + i_1 + i_2) + 1 ->
    (* next pointer at start x_3 is a8 *)
    a8 = m (shift a4 (1 + i_1 + i_2)) ->
    (* tail from x_5 with length i_3 *)
    p_linked_n t m a8 a4 (2 + i_1 + i_2) i_3 a3 ->
    (* then list from x_3 with length 1+i_3 *)
    p_linked_n t m a8 a4 (1 + i_1 + i_2) (1 + i_3) a3.
Proof.
  intros t m a8 a4 a3 i_1 i_2 i_3 Hi3 Hx5 Ha8 Htail.
  (* fold one step; head is a8 itself in this abstract statement *)
  eapply p_linked_n_succ_fold.
  - exact Hi3.
  - exact Ha8.
  - (* rewrite start+1 to x_5 *)
    replace (1 + i_1 + i_2 + 1) with (2 + i_1 + i_2) by lia.
    (* also rewrite (start+1) using Hx5 if needed *)
    exact Htail.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtA_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtA_eq :
  forall (B : Type) (f : addr -> B) (x : addr) (v : B),
    fun_updtA f x v x = v.
Proof.
  intros B f x v. unfold fun_updtA.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec x x) as [_|H]; [reflexivity|contradiction].
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtA_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtA_neq :
  forall (B : Type) (f : addr -> B) (x y : addr) (v : B),
    y <> x ->
    fun_updtA f x v y = f y.
Proof.
  intros B f x y v Hneq. unfold fun_updtA.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec y x) as [Heq|_]; [contradiction|reflexivity].
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtA_commute_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtA_commute_neq :
  forall (B : Type) (f : addr -> B) (x1 x2 : addr) (v1 v2 : B),
    x1 <> x2 ->
    fun_updtA (fun_updtA f x1 v1) x2 v2 =
    fun_updtA (fun_updtA f x2 v2) x1 v1.
Proof.
  intros B f x1 x2 v1 v2 Hneq.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro y.
  unfold fun_updtA.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec y x2) as [Hy2|Hy2];
  destruct (addr_eq_dec y x1) as [Hy1|Hy1]; subst; try reflexivity.
  exfalso; apply Hneq; reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: separated_mono

Lemma separated_mono :

    0 <= s2' <= s2 ->
    separated a1 s1 a2 s2 ->
    separated a1 s1' a2 s2'.
Proof.
  intros a1 s1 a2 s2 s1' s2' H1 H2 Hsep.
  eapply separated_mono_r; [exact H2|].
  eapply separated_mono_l; [exact H1|exact Hsep].
Qed.

Lemma shift_same_base_eq_iff :

offline_helper_lemmas.name: shift_same_base_neq_iff

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtA_read_shift_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtA_read_shift_neq :
  forall (B : Type) (f : addr -> B) a i j v,
    i <> j ->
    fun_updtA f (shift a i) v (shift a j) = f (shift a j).
Proof.
  intros B f a i j v Hneq.
  apply fun_updtA_neq.
  intro Heq.
  apply (proj1 (shift_same_base_eq_iff a j i)) in Heq.
  apply Hneq. symmetry. exact Heq.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: separated_preserved_by_update_away
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma separated_preserved_by_update_away :
  forall (f : addr -> addr) (x y u : addr) (v : addr) s1 s2,
    x <> u ->
    y <> u ->
    separated (f x) s1 (f y) s2 ->
    separated (fun_updtA f u v x) s1 (fun_updtA f u v y) s2.
Proof.
  intros f x y u v s1 s2 Hxu Hyu Hsep.
  rewrite (fun_updtA_neq _ f u x v Hxu).
  rewrite (fun_updtA_neq _ f u y v Hyu).
  exact Hsep.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: separated_update_shift_shift
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma separated_update_shift_shift :
  forall (a_5 : addr -> addr) a_4 i3 i4 i5 (null : addr),
    i5 <> i3 ->
    i4 <> i3 ->
    separated (a_5 (shift a_4 i5)) 4 (a_5 (shift a_4 i4)) 4 ->
    separated (fun_updtA a_5 (shift a_4 i3) null (shift a_4 i5)) 4
              (fun_updtA a_5 (shift a_4 i3) null (shift a_4 i4)) 4.
Proof.
  intros a_5 a_4 i3 i4 i5 null Hi5 Hi4 Hsep.
  eapply separated_preserved_by_update_away with (u := shift a_4 i3) (v := null).
  - intro H. apply (proj1 (shift_same_base_eq_iff a_4 i5 i3)) in H. exact (Hi5 H).
  - intro H. apply (proj1 (shift_same_base_eq_iff a_4 i4 i3)) in H. exact (Hi4 H).
  - exact Hsep.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: instantiate_pairwise_separated
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma instantiate_pairwise_separated :
  forall (F : Z -> addr) (lo hi i4 i5 : Z),
    i4 <> i5 ->
    lo <= i4 -> i4 < hi ->
    lo <= i5 -> i5 < hi ->
    (forall i7 i6,
        i7 <> i6 ->
        lo <= i6 -> lo <= i7 ->
        i6 < hi -> i7 < hi ->
        separated (F i7) 4 (F i6) 4) ->
    separated (F i5) 4 (F i4) 4.
Proof.
  intros F lo hi i4 i5 Hneq Hlo4 Hhi4 Hlo5 Hhi5 Hall.
  apply (Hall i5 i4); lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtZ_preserve_neq

Lemma fun_updtZ_preserve_neq {B : Type} (f : Z -> B) (x y z : Z) (v : B) :

  fun_updtZ f x v y <> fun_updtZ f x v z.
Proof.
  intros Hy Hz Hneq.
  rewrite (fun_updtZ_neq f x y v Hy).
  rewrite (fun_updtZ_neq f x z v Hz).
  exact Hneq.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: Z_interval_shift
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma Z_interval_shift (index n y : Z) :
  index <= y < index + n + 1 ->
  (y = index + n) \/ (y < index + n).
Proof.
  intro H.
  assert (y <= index + n) by lia.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec y (index + n)) as [Heq|Hneq].
  - left; exact Heq.
  - right; lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: use_unique_with_bounds
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma use_unique_with_bounds
  (t3 : Z -> Z) (a4 : Z -> Z) (i2 x i6 i7 : Z) :
  (forall j k : Z,
      j <> k ->
      i2 <= k ->
      i2 <= j ->
      k < x ->
      j < x ->
      t3 (a4 j) <> t3 (a4 k)) ->
  i7 <> i6 ->
  i2 <= i6 ->
  i2 <= i7 ->
  i6 < x ->
  i7 < x ->
  t3 (a4 i7) <> t3 (a4 i6).
Proof.
  intros Huniq Hne Hb6 Hb7 Hlt6 Hlt7.
  eapply Huniq; eauto.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: injective_on_interval_implies_unique
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma injective_on_interval_implies_unique
  (A : Type) (f : Z -> A) (lo hi : Z) :
  (forall y z, lo <= y < hi -> lo <= z < hi -> f y = f z -> y = z) ->
  forall y z, lo <= y < hi -> lo <= z < hi -> y <> z -> f y <> f z.
Proof.
  intros Hinj y z Hy Hz Hneq Heq.
  apply Hneq.
  apply Hinj; auto.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: unique_implies_injective_on_interval
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma unique_implies_injective_on_interval
  (A : Type) (f : Z -> A) (lo hi : Z) :
  (forall y z, lo <= y < hi -> lo <= z < hi -> y <> z -> f y <> f z) ->
  forall y z, lo <= y < hi -> lo <= z < hi -> f y = f z -> y = z.
Proof.
  intros Huniq y z Hy Hz Heq.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec y z) as [->|Hne]; auto.
  exfalso.
  apply (Huniq y z Hy Hz Hne).
  exact Heq.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: wp_no_earlier_match_repack
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma wp_no_earlier_match_repack :
  forall (addr : Type)
         (t1 : addr -> addr)
         (shift : addr -> Z -> addr)
         (a a1 : addr)
         (i2 i1 : Z),
    (forall k : Z, k < i1 -> i2 <= k -> ~(a1 = t1 (shift a k))) ->
    (forall k : Z, i2 <= k < i1 -> t1 (shift a k) <> a1).
Proof.
  intros addr t1 shift a a1 i2 i1 H k Hk.
  destruct Hk as [Hge Hlt].
  (* From ~(a1 = t1(...)) derive t1(...) <> a1 *)
  intro Heq.
  apply (H k Hlt Hge).
  symmetry; exact Heq.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: bounds_chain_from_wp
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma bounds_chain_from_wp :
  forall i i1 i2 : Z,
    0 <= i ->
    i1 <= i ->
    i1 < i ->
    i2 <= i1 ->
    0 <= i2 ->
    i2 < i.
Proof.
  intros i i1 i2 Hi Hi1le Hi1lt Hi2le Hi2ge.
  assert (i2 < i1 \/ i2 = i1) as Hcases by lia.
  destruct Hcases as [Hlt | Heq].
  - (* i2 < i1 < i *)
    lia.
  - (* i2 = i1 < i *)
    subst; lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: goal7_apply_extend_left_with_x1_x3
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma goal7_apply_extend_left_with_x1_x3 :
  forall (t : Z -> Z) (t_1 : addr -> addr)
         (a a_2 : addr) (i i_1 i_2 : Z) (a_3 a_1 : addr),
    let x1 := i + i_2 in
    let x3 := i + i_2 - 1 in
    p_linked_n t t_1 (t_1 (shift a_2 x1)) a_2 x1 (i_1 - i_2) a_3 ->
    p_linked_n t t_1 (t_1 (shift a_2 x3)) a_2 x3 (1 + i_1 - i_2) a_3.
Proof.
  intros t t_1 a a_2 i i_1 i_2 a_3 a_1.
  cbn.
  intro H.
  (* Extend left: length becomes (i_1 - i_2) + 1. *)
  pose proof (p_linked_n_extend_left t t_1 a a_2 a_2 (i + i_2) (i_1 - i_2) a_3 H) as Hext.
  (* Normalize the resulting length to the goal's length. *)
  replace (i_1 - i_2 + 1) with (1 + i_1 - i_2) in Hext by lia.
  exact Hext.
Qed.

Lemma p_linked_n_use_let_a3 :
  forall (Hshift0 : forall a : addr, shift a 0 = a)
         (t : Z -> Z) (t1 : addr -> addr)
         (a a2 : addr) (i_1 i_3 : Z),
    let x := i_1 + i_3 - 1 in
    let a_3 := t1 (shift (t1 (shift a2 x)) 0) in
    p_linked_n t t1 a a2 i_1 i_3 a_3 ->
    p_linked_n t t1 a a2 i_1 i_3 (t1 (t1 (shift a2 (i_1 + i_3 - 1)))).

  intros Hshift0 t t1 a a2 i_1 i_3 x a_3 Hp.
  subst x a_3.
  rewrite (rewrite_nested_shift0 Hshift0 t1 a2 (i_1 + i_3 - 1)) in Hp.
  exact Hp.
Qed.

Lemma fun_updt_neq :
  forall (A : Type) (f : addr -> A) (k x : addr) (v : A),
    x <> k ->
    fun_updt f k v x = f x.
Proof.
  intros A f k x v Hneq.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (addr_eqb x k) eqn:Hb.
  - exfalso.
    apply (proj1 (addr_eqb_spec x k)) in Hb.
    exact (Hneq Hb).
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma fun_updt_shadow :
  forall (A : Type) (f : addr -> A) (k : addr) (v1 v2 : A),
    fun_updt (fun_updt f k v1) k v2 = fun_updt f k v2.
Proof.
  intros A f k v1 v2.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro x.
  destruct (classic (x = k)) as [Heq|Hneq].
  - subst. repeat rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
  - repeat rewrite fun_updt_neq by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_neq :
  forall (B : Type) (t1 : addr -> B) (a a1 : addr) (v : B),
    a <> a1 ->
    fun_updt t1 a1 v a = t1 a.
Proof.
  intros B t1 a a1 v Hneq.
  (* fun_updt_other expects y <> x, i.e. a <> a1 *)
  apply fun_updt_other.
  exact Hneq.
Qed.

Qed.

Qed.

    p_linked_n t t1 head a2 i1 i null ->
    m = t1 ->
    p_linked_n t m head a2 i1 i null.
Proof.
  intros t t1 m head a2 i1 i null H Hm.
  subst m. exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: p_linked_n_ext
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma p_linked_n_ext :
  forall (t : Z -> Z) (f g : addr -> addr)

    p_linked_n t f head a2 i1 i null ->
    p_linked_n t g head a2 i1 i null.
Proof.
  intros t f g head a2 i1 i null Heq H.
  assert (f = g) as Hfg by (apply fun_ext; exact Heq).
  subst g. exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_eq :
  forall (f : addr -> addr) (k v : addr),
    fun_updt f k v k = v.
Proof.
  intros f k v.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec k k) as [_|H]; [reflexivity|contradiction].
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_neq :
  forall (f : addr -> addr) (k v x : addr),
    x <> k ->
    fun_updt f k v x = f x.
Proof.
  intros f k v x Hx.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec x k) as [Heq|Hneq].
  - contradiction.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_shadow
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_shadow :
  forall (f : addr -> addr) (k v1 v2 : addr),
    fun_updt (fun_updt f k v1) k v2 = fun_updt f k v2.
Proof.
  intros f k v1 v2.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro x.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec x k) as [->|Hneq].
  - destruct (addr_eq_dec k k) as [_|H]; [reflexivity|contradiction].
  - destruct (addr_eq_dec x k) as [H|_]; [contradiction|].
    reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_ext
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_ext :
  forall (f g : addr -> addr),
    (forall x, f x = g x) ->
    f = g.
Proof.
  intros f g H.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro x; apply H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_same_value
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_same_value :
  forall (f : addr -> addr) (a : addr),
    fun_updt f a (f a) = f.
Proof.
  intros f a.
  apply fun_updt_ext; intro x.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec x a) as [->|Hneq].
  - rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
  - rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hneq. reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_apply_cases
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_apply_cases :
  forall (f : addr -> addr) (a v x : addr),
    fun_updt f a v x = (if addr_eq_dec x a then v else f x).
Proof.
  intros f a v x.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec x a) as [Heq|Hneq].
  - subst. rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
  - rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hneq. reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_twice_other_point
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_twice_other_point :
  forall (f : addr -> addr) (a v1 v2 x : addr),
    x <> a ->
    fun_updt (fun_updt f a v1) a v2 x = f x.
Proof.
  intros f a v1 v2 x Hneq.
  (* Outer update at a does not affect x *)
  rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hneq.
  (* Inner update at a does not affect x *)
  rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hneq.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: injective_on_range_use
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma injective_on_range_use :
  forall (t1 : addr -> addr) (a1 : addr) (i1 x i2 i3 : Z),
    (forall (j k : Z),
        j <> k ->
        i1 <= k -> i1 <= j ->
        k < x -> j < x ->
        t1 (shift a1 j) <> t1 (shift a1 k)) ->
    i2 <> i3 ->
    i1 <= i2 -> i1 <= i3 ->

  specialize (Hinj i2 i3 Hneq Hi3 Hi2 Hlt3 Hlt2).

Lemma fun_updtZ_eq {B : Type} (f : Z -> B) (x : Z) (v : B) :

Proof.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtZ_neq

Proof.
  intro Hneq. unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec y x) as [Heq|]; [contradiction|reflexivity].
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtZ_shadow
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtZ_shadow {B : Type} (f : Z -> B) (x : Z) (v1 v2 : B) :
  fun_updtZ (fun_updtZ f x v1) x v2 = fun_updtZ f x v2.
Proof.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro y.
  unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec y x); reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtZ_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtZ_comm {B : Type} (f : Z -> B) (x1 x2 : Z) (v1 v2 : B) :
  x1 <> x2 ->
  fun_updtZ (fun_updtZ f x1 v1) x2 v2 =
  fun_updtZ (fun_updtZ f x2 v2) x1 v1.
Proof.
  intro Hneq.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro y.
  unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec y x2) as [Hy2|Hy2];
  destruct (Z.eq_dec y x1) as [Hy1|Hy1]; subst; try reflexivity; try contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma unchangedZ_update_outside {B : Type}
    (pre : Z -> B) (x : Z) (v : B) (lo hi : Z) :
  (forall i, lo <= i < hi -> i <> x) ->
  unchangedZ pre (fun_updtZ pre x v) lo hi.
Proof.
  intros Hneq i Hi.
  unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec i x) as [Heq|Hne].
  - exfalso. apply (Hneq i Hi). exact Heq.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Proof.

  intros i Hi.

Lemma unchangedZ_two_updates_outside {B : Type}

Proof.
  intros Hout1 Hout2 i Hi.
  unfold fun_updtZ.

  - destruct Hout2 as [H|H]; lia.
  - destruct (Z.eq_dec i x1) as [Heq1|Hne1].

    + reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_shadow
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_shadow :
  forall (f : addr -> addr) (k : addr) (v1 v2 : addr),
    fun_updt (fun_updt f k v1) k v2 = fun_updt f k v2.
Proof.
  intros f k v1 v2.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro x.
  destruct (classic (x = k)) as [->|Hneq].
  - repeat rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
  - repeat rewrite fun_updt_neq by assumption. reflexivity.
Qed.

    fun_updt (fun_updt f k1 v1) k2 v2 x = f x.
Proof.
  intros f k1 k2 x v1 v2 Hx1 Hx2.
  rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hx2.
  rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hx1.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros f k1 k2 k3 x v1 v2 v3 H1 H2 H3.
  rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact H3.
  rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact H2.
  rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact H1.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

  fun_updt m k v x = m x.
Proof.
  intro Hxk.
  unfold fun_updt.
  rewrite addr_eqb_neq by exact Hxk.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_comm {A : Type} (m : addr -> A) (k1 k2 : addr) (v1 v2 : A) :
  k1 <> k2 ->
  fun_updt (fun_updt m k1 v1) k2 v2 =
  fun_updt (fun_updt m k2 v2) k1 v1.
Proof.
  intro Hneq.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro x.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (addr_eqb x k2) eqn:H2;
  destruct (addr_eqb x k1) eqn:H1; try reflexivity.
  exfalso.
  apply (proj1 (addr_eqb_spec x k2)) in H2.
  apply (proj1 (addr_eqb_spec x k1)) in H1.
  subst. contradiction.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtb_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtb_comm :
  forall (f : addr -> addr) (k1 k2 : addr) (v1 v2 : addr),
    k1 <> k2 ->
    fun_updtb (fun_updtb f k1 v1) k2 v2 =
    fun_updtb (fun_updtb f k2 v2) k1 v1.
Proof.
  intros f k1 k2 v1 v2 Hneq.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro x.
  unfold fun_updtb.
  destruct (addr_eqb x k2) eqn:E2, (addr_eqb x k1) eqn:E1; try reflexivity.

  apply (proj1 (addr_eqb_spec x k2)) in E2.

  subst. contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma wp_sep_range_repackage :
  forall (t3 : addr -> addr) (a3 a6 : addr) (i1 x1 : Z) (BIG : Z),

offline_helper_lemmas.name: eval_a11_cases
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma eval_a11_cases :
  forall (a_8 : addr -> addr) (a_2 a_3 a_4 a_7 a_9 : addr) (i_2 : Z),
    let a_10 := fun_updt (fun_updt a_8 (shift a_3 0) a_9) a_7 a_3 in
    let a_11 := fun_updt a_10 a_2 a_3 in
    a_11 (shift a_4 i_2) =
      (if addr_eq_dec (shift a_4 i_2) a_2 then a_3
       else if addr_eq_dec (shift a_4 i_2) a_7 then a_3
       else if addr_eq_dec (shift a_4 i_2) (shift a_3 0) then a_9
       else a_8 (shift a_4 i_2)).
Proof.
  intros a_8 a_2 a_3 a_4 a_7 a_9 i_2.
  cbn.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec (shift a_4 i_2) a_2) as [H2|H2].
  - subst. reflexivity.
  - destruct (addr_eq_dec (shift a_4 i_2) a_7) as [H7|H7].
    + subst. reflexivity.
    + destruct (addr_eq_dec (shift a_4 i_2) (shift a_3 0)) as [H30|H30].
      * subst. reflexivity.
      * reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: separated_after_a11_case_split
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma separated_after_a11_case_split :
  forall (a_8 : addr -> addr) (a_2 a_3 a_4 a_7 a_9 : addr) (i_2 : Z),
    separated a_2 1 a_3 4 ->
    separated a_2 1 a_9 4 ->
    separated a_2 1 (a_8 (shift a_4 i_2)) 4 ->
    let a_10 := fun_updt (fun_updt a_8 (shift a_3 0) a_9) a_7 a_3 in
    let a_11 := fun_updt a_10 a_2 a_3 in
    separated a_2 1 (a_11 (shift a_4 i_2)) 4.
Proof.
  intros a_8 a_2 a_3 a_4 a_7 a_9 i_2 Hsep23 Hsep29 Hsep8.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec (shift a_4 i_2) a_2) as [Heq2|Hneq2].
  - exact Hsep23.
  - destruct (addr_eq_dec (shift a_4 i_2) a_7) as [Heq7|Hneq7].
    + exact Hsep23.
    + destruct (addr_eq_dec (shift a_4 i_2) (shift a_3 0)) as [Heq30|Hneq30].
      * exact Hsep29.
      * exact Hsep8.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtD_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtD_eq :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})
         (f : A -> B) (x : A) (v : B),
    fun_updtD eq_dec f x v x = v.
Proof.
  intros. unfold fun_updtD.
  destruct (eq_dec x x) as [E|Hneq].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtD_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtD_neq :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})
         (f : A -> B) (x y : A) (v : B),
    y <> x ->
    fun_updtD eq_dec f x v y = f y.
Proof.
  intros. unfold fun_updtD.
  destruct (eq_dec y x) as [E|Hneq].
  - exfalso. apply H. exact E.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtD_shadow
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtD_shadow :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})
         (f : A -> B) (x : A) (v1 v2 : B),
    fun_updtD eq_dec (fun_updtD eq_dec f x v1) x v2
    = fun_updtD eq_dec f x v2.
Proof.
  intros. apply functional_extensionality; intro y.
  unfold fun_updtD.
  destruct (eq_dec y x); reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtD_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtD_comm :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})
         (f : A -> B) (x1 x2 : A) (v1 v2 : B),
    x1 <> x2 ->
    fun_updtD eq_dec (fun_updtD eq_dec f x1 v1) x2 v2
    = fun_updtD eq_dec (fun_updtD eq_dec f x2 v2) x1 v1.
Proof.
  intros. apply functional_extensionality; intro y.
  unfold fun_updtD.
  destruct (eq_dec y x2) as [E2|Hneq2].
  - subst y.
    destruct (eq_dec x2 x1) as [E21|Hneq21].
    + exfalso. apply H. symmetry. exact E21.
    + destruct (eq_dec x2 x1) as [E21'|Hneq21']; [exfalso; apply Hneq21; exact E21'|reflexivity].
  - destruct (eq_dec y x1) as [E1|Hneq1].
    + subst y.
      destruct (eq_dec x1 x2) as [E12|Hneq12].
      * exfalso. apply H. exact E12.
      * destruct (eq_dec x1 x1) as [E11|Hneq11]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply Hneq11; reflexivity].
    + destruct (eq_dec y x1) as [E|Hneq]; [exfalso; apply Hneq1; exact E|].
      destruct (eq_dec y x2) as [E|Hneq']; [exfalso; apply Hneq2; exact E|reflexivity].
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: unchangedZ_fun_updt_outside

Lemma unchangedZ_fun_updt_outside
  {A : Type} (m : Z -> A) (k : Z) (v : A) (lo hi : Z) :
  (k < lo \/ hi <= k) ->
  unchangedZ (fun_updt m k v) m lo hi.
Proof.
  intro Hout.
  unfold unchangedZ.
  intros i Hi.
  assert (i <> k) by lia.
  rewrite (fun_updt_neq m k i v); auto.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: unchangedZ_fun_updt_inside_split
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma unchangedZ_fun_updt_inside_split
  {A : Type} (m : Z -> A) (k : Z) (v : A) (lo hi : Z) :
  lo <= k < hi ->
  unchangedZ (fun_updt m k v) m lo k /\
  unchangedZ (fun_updt m k v) m (k + 1) hi.
Proof.
  intro Hk.
  split.
  - unfold unchangedZ.
    intros i Hi.
    assert (i <> k) by lia.
    rewrite (fun_updt_neq m k i v); auto.
  - unfold unchangedZ.
    intros i Hi.
    assert (i <> k) by lia.
    rewrite (fun_updt_neq m k i v); auto.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: unchangedZ_update_at_k_if_k_not_in_image
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma unchangedZ_update_at_k_if_k_not_in_image
  {A : Type} (m : addr -> A) (k : addr) (v : A)
  (base : Z) (lo hi : Z) (shift : Z -> addr) :
  (forall j : Z, lo <= j < hi -> shift (base + j) <> k) ->
  unchangedZ (fun j => fun_updt m k v (shift (base + j)))
             (fun j => m (shift (base + j))) lo hi.
Proof.
  intro Hnotin.
  unfold unchangedZ.
  intros j Hj.
  specialize (Hnotin j Hj).
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec (shift (base + j)) k) as [Heq|Hne].
  - contradiction.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: assigns_loc_to_wp_disjunction
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma assigns_loc_to_wp_disjunction :
  forall (a1 a4 a2 : addr) (x1 i i1 : Z),
    assigns_loc a1 a4 a2 x1 i i1 ->
    a4 = a1 \/
    shift (shift a2 (x1 - 1)) 0 = a4 \/
    included a4 1 (shift a2 x1) (i + i1 - x1).
Proof.
  intros a1 a4 a2 x1 i i1 Hass.
  destruct Hass as [Hlist | Hnext | Hinc].
  - left; exact Hlist.
  - right; left; exact Hnext.
  - right; right; exact Hinc.
Qed.

    assigns_loc a1 a4 a2 x1 i i1.
Proof.
  intros a1 a4 a2 x1 i i1 Hdisj.
  destruct Hdisj as [H | [H | H]].
  - apply Assigns_list_cell; exact H.
  - apply Assigns_prev_next; exact H.

Lemma addr_eqb_eq : forall x y : addr, addr_eqb x y = true <-> x = y.
Proof.
  intros x y; unfold addr_eqb.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec x y) as [->|Hneq].
  - split; intro; reflexivity.
  - split; intro H.

    + contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma injective_on_range_contrapositive :
  forall (t2 : addr -> addr) (a2 : addr) (lo hi i5 i6 : Z),
    (forall j k : Z,
        j <> k ->
        lo <= k -> lo <= j ->
        k < hi -> j < hi ->
        t2 (shift a2 j) <> t2 (shift a2 k)) ->
    lo <= i5 -> lo <= i6 ->
    i5 < hi -> i6 < hi ->
    t2 (shift a2 i6) = t2 (shift a2 i5) ->
    i6 = i5.
Proof.
  intros t2 a2 lo hi i5 i6 Huniq Hlo5 Hlo6 Hhi5 Hhi6 Heq.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec i6 i5) as [->|Hne]; [reflexivity|].
  exfalso.
  specialize (Huniq i6 i5 Hne Hlo5 Hlo6 Hhi5 Hhi6).
  apply Huniq.
  exact Heq.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_idem
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_idem :
  forall (f : addr -> addr) (k v : addr),
    fun_updt (fun_updt f k v) k v = fun_updt f k v.
Proof.
  intros f k v.
  apply functional_extensionality.
  intro x.
  destruct (classic (x = k)) as [->|Hneq].
  - rewrite fun_updt_eq. rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
  - rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hneq.
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hneq.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_comm :
  forall (f : addr -> addr) (k1 v1 k2 v2 : addr),
    k1 <> k2 ->
    fun_updt (fun_updt f k1 v1) k2 v2 =
    fun_updt (fun_updt f k2 v2) k1 v1.
Proof.
  intros f k1 v1 k2 v2 Hk.
  apply functional_extensionality.
  intro x.
  destruct (classic (x = k1)) as [Hx1|Hx1];
  destruct (classic (x = k2)) as [Hx2|Hx2].
  - (* x=k1 and x=k2: impossible *)
    exfalso. apply Hk. now transitivity x.
  - (* x=k1, x<>k2 *)
    subst x.
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hk.
    rewrite fun_updt_eq.
    rewrite fun_updt_eq.
    reflexivity.
  - (* x<>k1, x=k2 *)
    subst x.
    rewrite fun_updt_eq.
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by (intro E; apply Hk; symmetry; exact E).
    rewrite fun_updt_eq.
    reflexivity.
  - (* x<>k1, x<>k2 *)
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hx2.
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hx1.
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hx1.
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hx2.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtZ_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtZ_eq {B : Type} (f : Z -> B) (x : Z) (v : B) :
  fun_updtZ f x v x = v.
Proof.
  unfold fun_updtZ. destruct (Z.eq_dec x x) as [_|H]; [reflexivity|lia].
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtZ_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtZ_neq {B : Type} (f : Z -> B) (x y : Z) (v : B) :
  y <> x ->
  fun_updtZ f x v y = f y.
Proof.
  intro Hneq.
  unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec y x) as [Heq|Hne].
  - exfalso; apply Hneq; exact Heq.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtZ_id
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtZ_id {B : Type} (f : Z -> B) (x : Z) :
  fun_updtZ f x (f x) = f.
Proof.
  apply functional_extensionality.
  intro y.
  unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec y x) as [->|Hne]; reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: eqs1_list_load_of_memory_ext
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma eqs1_list_load_of_memory_ext :
  forall (p : addr) (t1 : addr -> R) (m1 m2 : addr -> addr),
    (forall q : addr, m1 q = m2 q) ->
    eqs1_list (load_s1_list p t1 m1) (load_s1_list p t1 m2).
Proof.
  intros p t1 m1 m2 Hext.
  apply eqs1_list_of_eq.
  assert (m1 = m2) as ->.
  { apply functional_extensionality. intro q. apply Hext. }
  reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_pointwise_eq_if_same_value
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_pointwise_eq_if_same_value :
  forall (t2 : addr -> addr) (a : addr) (v : addr),
    v = t2 a ->
    (forall q : addr, fun_updt t2 a v q = t2 q).
Proof.
  intros t2 a v Hv q.
  destruct (classic (q = a)) as [->|Hne].
  - rewrite fun_updt_eq. now rewrite Hv.
  - rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hne. reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: eqs1_list_load_after_update_same_value
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma eqs1_list_load_after_update_same_value :
  forall (t2 : addr -> addr) (a p : addr) (t1 : addr -> R),
    eqs1_list (load_s1_list p t1 (fun_updt t2 a (t2 a)))
             (load_s1_list p t1 t2).
Proof.
  intros t2 a p t1.
  apply eqs1_list_load_of_memory_ext.
  intro q.
  destruct (classic (q = a)) as [->|Hne].
  - rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
  - rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hne. reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_eq {A B : Type}
  (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})
  (f : A -> B) (x : A) (v : B) :
  fun_updt eq_dec f x v x = v.
Proof.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (eq_dec x x) as [H|H].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; apply H; reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_neq {A B : Type}
  (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})
  (f : A -> B) (x y : A) (v : B) :
  y <> x -> fun_updt eq_dec f x v y = f y.
Proof.
  intro Hneq.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (eq_dec y x) as [Heq|Hne].
  - exfalso; apply Hneq; exact Heq.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_congr
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_congr {A B : Type}
  (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})
  (f g : A -> B) (x : A) (v w : B) :
  (forall y, f y = g y) ->
  v = w ->
  forall y, fun_updt eq_dec f x v y = fun_updt eq_dec g x w y.
Proof.
  intros Hfg Hvw y.
  subst w.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (eq_dec y x); now rewrite ?Hfg.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: unchanged_on_mono

Lemma unchanged_on_mono {K V : Type} (key : Z -> K) (m1 m2 : K -> V)

  lo1 <= lo2 ->
  hi2 <= hi1 ->
  unchanged_on key m1 m2 lo1 hi1 ->
  unchanged_on key m1 m2 lo2 hi2.
Proof.
  intros Hlo Hhi Hbig.
  unfold unchanged_on in *.
  intros i Hi.
  apply Hbig.
  lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: unchanged_on_split
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma unchanged_on_split {K V : Type} (key : Z -> K) (m1 m2 : K -> V)
  (lo mid hi : Z) :
  lo <= mid <= hi ->
  (unchanged_on key m1 m2 lo hi <->
     (unchanged_on key m1 m2 lo mid /\ unchanged_on key m1 m2 mid hi)).
Proof.
  intro Hbounds.
  split.
  - intro Hall; split; unfold unchanged_on in *; intros i Hi; apply Hall; lia.
  - intros [Hlm Hmh].
    unfold unchanged_on in *.
    intros i Hi.
    destruct (Z_lt_ge_dec i mid) as [Hlt|Hge].
    + apply Hlm; lia.
    + apply Hmh; lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: unchanged_on_fun_updt_avoids_key
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma unchanged_on_fun_updt_avoids_key
  {K V : Type}
  (eq_dec : forall (u v : K), {u = v} + {u <> v})
  (key : Z -> K) (m : K -> V) (k0 : K) (v : V) (lo hi : Z) :
  (forall i : Z, lo <= i < hi -> key i <> k0) ->
  unchanged_on key m (fun_updt eq_dec m k0 v) lo hi.
Proof.
  intro Havoid.
  unfold unchanged_on.
  intros i Hi.
  specialize (Havoid i Hi).
  rewrite fun_updt_neq; auto.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: unchanged_on_preserved_by_fun_updt_right
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma unchanged_on_preserved_by_fun_updt_right
  {K V : Type}
  (eq_dec : forall (u v : K), {u = v} + {u <> v})
  (key : Z -> K) (m m' : K -> V) (k0 : K) (v : V) (lo hi : Z) :
  unchanged_on key m m' lo hi ->
  (forall i : Z, lo <= i < hi -> key i <> k0) ->
  unchanged_on key m (fun_updt eq_dec m' k0 v) lo hi.
Proof.
  intros Hunch Havoid.
  unfold unchanged_on in *.
  intros i Hi.
  rewrite fun_updt_neq.
  - apply Hunch; exact Hi.
  - apply Havoid; exact Hi.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: unchanged_on_glue
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma unchanged_on_glue {K V : Type} (key : Z -> K) (m1 m2 : K -> V)

offline_helper_lemmas.name: p_linked_n_app_len1
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma p_linked_n_app_len1 :
  forall (t : Z -> Z) (t2 : addr -> addr)
         (a4 a3 : addr) (i1 i2 : Z) (a a5 : addr),
    p_linked_n t t2 a4 a3 i1 (i2 - i1) a ->
    p_linked_n t t2 a  a3 i2 1 a5 ->
    p_linked_n t t2 a4 a3 i1 ((i2 - i1) + 1) a5.
Proof.
  intros t t2 a4 a3 i1 i2 a a5 Hleft Hright.
  eapply p_linked_n_app.
  - exact Hleft.
  - replace (i1 + (i2 - i1)) with i2 by lia.
    exact Hright.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: p_linked_n_app_len1_goal_shape
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma p_linked_n_app_len1_goal_shape :
  forall (t : Z -> Z) (t2 : addr -> addr)
         (a4 a3 : addr) (i1 i2 : Z) (a a5 : addr),
    p_linked_n t t2 a4 a3 i1 (i2 - i1) a ->
    p_linked_n t t2 a  a3 i2 1 a5 ->
    p_linked_n t t2 a4 a3 i1 (1 + i2 - i1) a5.
Proof.
  intros t t2 a4 a3 i1 i2 a a5 Hleft Hright.
  pose proof (p_linked_n_app_len1 t t2 a4 a3 i1 i2 a a5 Hleft Hright) as Happ.
  replace (1 + i2 - i1) with ((i2 - i1) + 1) by lia.
  exact Happ.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: shift_eq_NULL_iff
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:

  - intro H.
    split.
    + eapply shift_eq_NULL_implies_region0; eauto.
    + eapply shift_eq_NULL_implies_offset; eauto.
  - intros [Hr Ho].

    + rewrite shift_offset. exact Ho.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_eq

Lemma fun_updt_eq :

Lemma fun_updt_shadow :
  forall (f : addr -> Z) (a : addr) (v1 v2 : Z),
    fun_updt (fun_updt f a v1) a v2 = fun_updt f a v2.
Proof.
  intros f a v1 v2.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro b.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (addr_eq_dec b a) as [Hba|Hba].
  - subst.
    destruct (addr_eq_dec a a) as [_|Hneq]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply Hneq; reflexivity].
  - destruct (addr_eq_dec b a) as [Hba'|_]; [contradiction|].
    reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: extract_then_branch_equalities
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma extract_then_branch_equalities :
  forall (i x i1 : Z)
         (t t1 : Z -> Z)
         (t2 : addr -> Z) (t4 t3 : addr -> Z)
         (t5 : addr -> addr)
         (a1 a4 a5 a : addr),
    (if decide (i < x) then
       i1 = i /\
       t1 = t /\
       l__memb_ptr t5 t2 a1 i1 = a /\
       fun_updt t4 a5 0 = t3
     else True) ->
    decide (i < x) = true ->
    i1 = i /\ l__memb_ptr t5 t2 a1 i1 = a /\ t3 = fun_updt t4 a5 0.
Proof.
  intros i x i1 t t1 t2 t4 t3 t5 a1 a4 a5 a H Hdec.
  rewrite Hdec in H.
  destruct H as (Hi1 & _Ht1 & Hptr & Hupd).
  subst i1.
  split; [reflexivity|].
  split; [exact Hptr|].
  symmetry; exact Hupd.
Qed.

Lemma extract_else_branch_equality :
  forall (i x : Z)
         (t4 t3 : addr -> Z),
    (if decide (i < x) then True else t4 = t3) ->
    decide (i < x) = false ->
    t3 = t4.
Proof.
  intros i x t4 t3 H Hdec.
  rewrite Hdec in H.
  symmetry; exact H.
Qed.

  forall (t5 : addr -> addr) (t2 : addr -> Z) (a1 a3 a : addr) (i i2 : Z),
    (forall j : Z,
        0 <= j -> j < i ->
        ~ shift (t5 a3) (j * t2 (shift a1 0)) = a) ->
    0 <= i2 ->
    i2 < i ->
    ~ shift (t5 a3) (i2 * t2 (shift a1 0)) = a.
Proof.
  intros t5 t2 a1 a3 a i i2 H H0 Hlt.
  eapply H; eauto.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma not_has_implies_read_zero_at_witness :
  forall (addr : Type)
         (read : addr -> Z)
         (addr_of : Z -> addr)
         (has : Prop)
         (i : Z),
    (has <-> (exists j : Z, j = i /\ read (addr_of j) <> 0)) ->
    ~ has ->
    read (addr_of i) = 0.
Proof.
  intros addr read addr_of has i Hdef Hn.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec (read (addr_of i)) 0) as [Hz|Hnz].
  - exact Hz.
  - exfalso.
    apply Hn.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: not_forall_range_not_to_exists
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma not_forall_range_not_to_exists :
  forall (i : Z) (E : Z -> Prop),
    ~ (forall i2 : Z, 0 <= i2 -> i2 < i -> ~ E i2) ->
    exists i2 : Z, 0 <= i2 /\ i2 < i /\ E i2.
Proof.
  intros i E H.
  set (P := fun i2 : Z => 0 <= i2 -> i2 < i -> ~ E i2).
  assert (Hex : exists i2 : Z, ~ P i2).
  { apply not_forall_to_exists_not. exact H. }
  destruct Hex as [i2 HnP].
  unfold P in HnP.

  (* 0 <= i2 *)
  assert (H0 : 0 <= i2).
  { destruct (Z_le_gt_dec 0 i2) as [Hle | Hgt]; [exact Hle|].
    exfalso.
    apply HnP.
    intros H0' _.
    exfalso.
    lia. }

  (* i2 < i *)
  assert (Hi : i2 < i).
  { destruct (Z_lt_ge_dec i2 i) as [Hlt | Hge]; [exact Hlt|].
    exfalso.
    apply HnP.
    intros _ Hi2.
    exfalso.
    apply Hge.
    exact Hi2. }

  (* E i2 *)
  assert (HE : E i2).
  { destruct (classic (E i2)) as [He | Hne]; [exact He|].
    exfalso.
    apply HnP.
    intros _ _.
    exact Hne. }

  exists i2; tauto.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma l_occ_a_step_0 :
  forall (mem : addr -> Z) (base : addr) (i : Z),
    0 <= i ->
    l_occ_a mem 0 base 0 (i + 1)
    = l_occ_a mem 0 base 0 i
      + (if Z.eq_dec (mem (shift base i)) 0 then 1 else 0).
Proof.
  intros mem base i Hi.
  apply (l_occ_a_step mem 0 base 0 i); lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: l_occ_a_succ_if_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma l_occ_a_succ_if_eq :
  forall (mem : addr -> Z) (v : Z) (base : addr) (lo i : Z),
    0 <= lo ->
    lo <= i ->
    mem (shift base i) = v ->
    l_occ_a mem v base lo (i + 1) = l_occ_a mem v base lo i + 1.
Proof.
  intros mem v base lo i Hlo Hi Heq.
  rewrite (l_occ_a_step mem v base lo i Hlo Hi).
  destruct (Z.eq_dec (mem (shift base i)) v) as [H|H].
  - lia.
  - exfalso. apply H. exact Heq.
Qed.

Proof.

  forall (mem : addr -> Z) (base : addr) (i : Z),
    0 <= i ->

       l_occ_a mem 0 base 0 (i + 1) = l_occ_a mem 0 base 0 i + 1)
    /\

Proof.
  intros mem base i Hi.
  split.
  - intro Heq. apply l_occ_a_succ_if_eq; lia.

Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: l_occ_a_bridge_wp_shape
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma l_occ_a_bridge_wp_shape :
  forall (mem : addr -> Z) (base : addr) (i2 i i1 : Z),
    0 <= i2 ->
    let x1 := l_occ_a mem 0 base 0 i2 in
    let x2 := 1 + i2 in
    let x3 := mem (shift base i2) in
    (if Z.eq_dec x3 0
     then (1 + i = i1 /\ x1 = i)
     else x1 = i1) ->
    l_occ_a mem 0 base 0 x2 = i1.
Proof.
  intros mem base i2 i i1 Hi2 x1 x2 x3 Hbranch.
  subst x1 x2 x3.
  (* Make the bound syntactically match the step lemma: (i2 + 1) *)
  replace (1 + i2) with (i2 + 1) by lia.
  rewrite (l_occ_a_step mem 0 base 0 i2); try lia.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec (mem (shift base i2)) 0) as [Hz|Hnz].
  - destruct Hbranch as [Hi1 Hx1].
    rewrite Hx1. lia.
  - rewrite Hbranch.
    destruct (Z.eq_dec (mem (shift base i2)) 0) as [Hc|Hc].
    + exfalso. apply Hnz. exact Hc.
    + lia.
Qed.

Lemma split_invariant_step
  (t : addr -> Z) (e : Z) (a : addr) (from cut i : Z) :
  (l_occ_a t e a from i = l_occ_a t e a from cut + l_occ_a t e a cut i) ->
  (l_occ_a t e a from (i + 1) =
     l_occ_a t e a from cut + l_occ_a t e a cut (i + 1)).
Proof.
  intro Hsplit.
  rewrite (l_occ_a_succ t e a from i).
  rewrite (l_occ_a_succ t e a cut i).

  lia.
Qed.

  (x + l_occ_a t e a cut (i + 1) = l_occ_a t e a from (i + 1)).
Proof.
  intros x H.
  rewrite (l_occ_a_succ t e a cut i).
  rewrite (l_occ_a_succ t e a from i).
  lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_shadow
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_shadow :
  forall (m : addr -> Z) (a : addr) (v1 v2 : Z) (x : addr),
    fun_updt (fun_updt m a v1) a v2 x = fun_updt m a v2 x.
Proof.
  intros m a v1 v2 x.
  destruct (classic (x = a)) as [->|Hneq].
  - rewrite fun_updt_eq. rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
  - assert (Hax : a <> x) by (intro H; apply Hneq; symmetry; exact H).
    (* LHS: update at a, then update at a, evaluated at x<>a *)
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hax.
    (* Now LHS is fun_updt m a v1 x, still x<>a *)
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hax.
    (* RHS: fun_updt m a v2 x, x<>a *)
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hax.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma upd_eq :
  forall (A B : Type) (dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (m : A -> B) (k : A) (v : B),
    upd dec m k v k = v.
Proof.
  intros A B dec m k v.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (dec k k) as [H|H].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; apply H; reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma upd_neq :
  forall (A B : Type) (dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (m : A -> B) (k x : A) (v : B),
    x <> k ->
    upd dec m k v x = m x.
Proof.
  intros A B dec m k x v Hxk.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (dec x k) as [H|H].
  - exfalso; apply Hxk; exact H.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

         (m : A -> B) (k : A) (v : B) (P : A -> Prop),
    (forall x, P x -> x <> k) ->
    (forall x, P x -> upd dec m k v x = m x).
Proof.
  intros A B dec m k v P H x Hpx.
  apply upd_neq; auto.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: addr_le_shift_add_with_trans
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma addr_le_shift_add_with_trans :
  forall (addr : Type) (shift : addr -> Z -> addr) (addr_le : addr -> addr -> Prop)
         (a : addr) (i j : Z),
    (forall x n m, shift (shift x n) m = shift x (n + m)) ->
    (forall x n, 0 <= n -> addr_le x (shift x n)) ->
    (forall x y z, addr_le x y -> addr_le y z -> addr_le x z) ->
    0 <= i ->
    0 <= j ->
    addr_le a (shift a (i + j)).
Proof.
  intros addr shift addr_le a i j Hassoc Hnonneg Htrans Hi Hj.
  pose proof (Hnonneg a i Hi) as H1.
  pose proof (Hnonneg (shift a i) j Hj) as H2.
  rewrite Hassoc in H2.
  eapply Htrans; eauto.
Qed.

Proof.

Proof.
  intros a a1 a3 a7 a5 i2 Hneq1 Hneq2 Heq.
  rewrite (fun_updt_read_other a3 a7 (shift a1 i2) a5 (not_eq_sym Hneq1)).
  rewrite (fun_updt_read_other a3 a7 (shift a i2) a5 (not_eq_sym Hneq2)).

offline_helper_lemmas.name: wp_disj_split

Lemma wp_disj_split :
  forall (A B C D E : Prop),
    (A \/ B \/ C \/ D \/ E) -> (A \/ B \/ C) \/ (D \/ E).
Proof.
  intros A B C D E H.
  destruct H as [HA | [HB | [HC | [HD | HE]]]].

  - left; right; left; exact HB.
  - left; right; right; exact HC.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: valid_rw_mono
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma valid_rw_mono
  (t : Z -> Z) (p : addr) (n m : Z) :
  valid_rw t p n -> 0 <= m -> m <= n -> valid_rw t p m.
Proof.
  (* In Frama-C/WP, this is typically a library lemma about memory validity.
     Here we keep it as a proved lemma by assuming it as a hypothesis would
     be necessary; but since the task requires proofs, we encode it as an
     axiom-free lemma by making it an explicit premise in later lemmas.
     Therefore, this lemma is stated but cannot be proved from nothing.
     To keep everything provable, we do not use it directly; instead we
     provide derived lemmas that take monotonicity as an explicit argument. *)
Abort.

(*
  Since we must provide proofs, we instead provide *schematic* helper lemmas
  that take monotonicity as an explicit hypothesis. This matches how one
  would use a library lemma in the WP development: you import it and apply it.
*)

Lemma valid_rw_mono_hyp
  (t : Z -> Z) (p : addr) (n m : Z) :
  (forall n m, valid_rw t p n -> 0 <= m -> m <= n -> valid_rw t p m) ->
  valid_rw t p n ->
  0 <= m ->
  m <= n ->
  valid_rw t p m.
Proof.
  intros Hmono Hn Hm0 Hmn.
  eapply Hmono; eauto.
Qed.

  valid_rw t p n ->
  0 <= m ->
  m <= n ->
  valid_rw t p m.
Proof.
  (* Same as valid_rw_mono_hyp, but named in a way that matches WP usage. *)
  intros; eapply valid_rw_mono_hyp; eauto.
Qed.

  (H : (~ x = 0) = (~ i = 0)) :
  (x <> 0 <-> i <> 0).
Proof.
  (* First turn equality of Props into an iff. *)
  apply prop_eq_to_iff in H.
  (* Now rewrite each side explicitly using the lemma. *)
  assert (Hx : (~ x = 0) <-> x <> 0) by apply not_Zeq_0_iff_neq.
  assert (Hi : (~ i = 0) <-> i <> 0) by apply not_Zeq_0_iff_neq.
  (* Chain the equivalences. *)
  exact (iff_trans (iff_sym Hx) (iff_trans H Hi)).
Qed.

  (x i : Z)

offline_helper_lemmas.name: minimal_witness_unique
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma minimal_witness_unique
  (P : Z -> Prop) (i k : Z) :
  0 <= i ->
  0 <= k ->
  P i ->
  (forall j : Z, 0 <= j < i -> ~ P j) ->
  P k ->
  (forall j : Z, 0 <= j < k -> ~ P j) ->
  i = k.
Proof.
  intros Hi Hk Pi MinI Pk MinK.
  destruct (Z.lt_trichotomy i k) as [Hik|[Heq|Hki]]; try exact Heq.
  - (* i < k *)
    assert (0 <= i) by exact Hi.
    assert (0 <= i < k) as Hik' by lia.
    specialize (MinK i Hik' Pi). contradiction.
  - (* k < i *)
    assert (0 <= k) by exact Hk.
    assert (0 <= k < i) as Hki' by lia.
    specialize (MinI k Hki' Pk). contradiction.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: wp_branch_extract
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma wp_branch_extract
  (i2 i1 x i i3 : Z) (A : Prop) :
  (i2 < i1 ->
     A /\ ((x <= i -> i3 = 1) /\ (~ (x <= i) -> i3 = 0))) ->
  (~ (i2 < i1) -> i3 = 0) ->
  ((i2 < i1 -> x <= i -> i3 = 1) /\
   (i2 < i1 -> ~ (x <= i) -> i3 = 0) /\
   (~ (i2 < i1) -> i3 = 0)).
Proof.
  intros Hlt Hnlt.
  repeat split.
  - intros Hi2 Hi.
    exact ((proj1 (proj2 (Hlt Hi2))) Hi).
  - intros Hi2 Hx.
    exact ((proj2 (proj2 (Hlt Hi2))) Hx).
  - exact Hnlt.
Qed.

Lemma prop_eq_from_iff_eq1_and_01
  (E : Prop) (i3 : Z) :
  (i3 = 0 \/ i3 = 1) ->
  (E <-> i3 = 1) ->
  (E = (~ i3 = 0)).
Proof.
  intros Hi3 Hiff.
  apply iff_prop_eq.
  (* goal: E <-> ~ i3 = 0 *)
  split.
  - intro HE.
    apply (proj1 Hiff) in HE.
    subst. discriminate.
  - intro Hnz.
    assert (i3 = 1) as Hi31.
    { destruct Hi3 as [H0|H1]; [exfalso; apply Hnz; exact H0|exact H1]. }
    apply (proj2 Hiff).
    exact Hi31.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: Z_rem_2_upper
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma Z_rem_2_upper :
  forall x : Z, 0 <= x -> Z.rem x 2 < 2.
Proof.
  intros x Hx.
  (* In Coq's ZArith, the lemma is [Z.rem_bound_pos]:
       0 <= a -> 0 < b -> 0 <= a mod b < b
     where [mod] is [Z.rem]. *)
  pose proof (Z.rem_bound_pos x 2 Hx ltac:(lia)) as H.
  (* H : 0 <= Z.rem x 2 < 2 *)
  lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: Z_rem_2_le_1
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma Z_rem_2_le_1 :
  forall x : Z, 0 <= x -> Z.rem x 2 <= 1.
Proof.
  intros x Hx.
  pose proof (Z_rem_2_upper x Hx) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Z_rem_2_range_nonneg x Hx) as Hge.
  lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: Z_rem_2_cases
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma Z_rem_2_cases :
  forall x : Z, 0 <= x -> Z.rem x 2 = 0 \/ Z.rem x 2 = 1.
Proof.
  intros x Hx.
  pose proof (Z_rem_2_range_nonneg x Hx) as Hge.
  pose proof (Z_rem_2_le_1 x Hx) as Hle.
  assert (Z.rem x 2 = 0 \/ Z.rem x 2 = 1 \/ (Z.rem x 2 < 0 \/ 1 < Z.rem x 2)) by lia.
  destruct H as [H0 | [H1 | Hbad]]; auto.
  destruct Hbad as [Hneg | Hgt]; lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma StrictLowerBound_weaken_k :
  forall (a : Z -> Z) (k1 k2 n val : Z),
    StrictLowerBound a k2 n val ->
    0 <= k1 <= k2 ->
    StrictLowerBound a k1 n val.
Proof.
  intros a k1 k2 n val [Hk2 Hforall] Hk1.
  split.
  - destruct Hk2 as [Hk2_0 Hk2_n].
    destruct Hk1 as [Hk1_0 Hk1_k2].

    lia.
  - intros j Hj.
    apply Hforall.
    destruct Hj as [Hj0 Hjk1].
    destruct Hk1 as [_ Hk1_k2].
    split; [exact Hj0|].
    lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: EqualRanges_implies_Unchanged_same
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma EqualRanges_implies_Unchanged_same :
  forall (A : Type) (m1 m0 : mem A) lo hi,
    EqualRanges m1 m0 lo hi lo ->
    Unchanged m0 m1 lo hi.
Proof.
  unfold EqualRanges, Unchanged.
  intros A m1 m0 lo hi Heq j Hj.
  set (k := j - lo).
  assert (Hk : 0 <= k < hi - lo) by (subst k; lia).
  specialize (Heq k Hk).
  subst k.
  replace (lo + (j - lo)) with j in Heq by lia.
  exact Heq.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: havoc_range_outside_unchanged
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma havoc_range_outside_unchanged :
  forall (A : Type) (old new : mem A) lo len,
    0 <= len ->
    Unchanged old (havoc_range old new lo len) (-2^62) lo /\
    Unchanged old (havoc_range old new lo len) (lo + len) (2^62).
Proof.
  intros A old new lo len Hlen.
  split.
  - unfold Unchanged, havoc_range.
    intros j Hj.
    destruct ((Z.leb lo j) && (Z.ltb j (lo + len))) eqn:Hb; simpl; try reflexivity.
    apply andb_true_iff in Hb as [H1 H2].
    apply Z.leb_le in H1.
    apply Z.ltb_lt in H2.
    lia.
  - unfold Unchanged, havoc_range.
    intros j Hj.
    destruct ((Z.leb lo j) && (Z.ltb j (lo + len))) eqn:Hb; simpl; try reflexivity.
    apply andb_true_iff in Hb as [H1 H2].
    apply Z.leb_le in H1.
    apply Z.ltb_lt in H2.
    lia.
Qed.

  forall (A : Type) (a_pre a_here a_next : mem A) (i2 i : Z),

offline_helper_lemmas.name: havoc_empty_range
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma havoc_empty_range :
  forall (t1 t2 : addr -> Z) (a1 : addr) (i : Z),
    i <= 0 ->
    forall p : addr, havoc t1 t2 a1 i p = t2 p.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 a1 i Hi p.
  (* We can represent p as shift a1 k only if shift is surjective, which we
     do not assume. So we cannot prove this without extra axioms.
     Instead, we provide a weaker but still useful lemma: equality on the
     specific footprint addresses shift a1 k. *)
Abort.

(*
  The lemma we can prove without surjectivity: havoc equals t2 on the footprint
  addresses shift a1 k for any k outside [0,i).
*)
Lemma havoc_eq_t2_on_outside_offsets :
  forall (t1 t2 : addr -> Z) (a1 : addr) (i k : Z),
    (k < 0 \/ i <= k) ->
    havoc t1 t2 a1 i (shift a1 k) = t2 (shift a1 k).
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 a1 i k H.
  apply havoc_outside; exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: transfer_multisetunchanged_along_unchanged
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma transfer_multisetunchanged_along_unchanged :
  forall (m : addr -> Z) (t2 : addr -> Z) (a : addr) (lo hi : Z),
    p_unchanged_1' m t2 a lo hi ->
    p_multisetunchanged_1' t2 t2 a lo hi ->
    p_multisetunchanged_1' m t2 a lo hi.
Proof.
  intros m t2 a lo hi Hunch Hms.
  apply (p_multisetunchanged_morphism t2 m t2 a lo hi).
  - (* eq_on lo hi t2 m a *)
    (* from unchanged we have eq_on lo hi m t2 a, so we can flip it *)
    unfold eq_on in *.
    intros k Hk.
    specialize (p_unchanged_implies_eq_on m t2 a lo hi Hunch k Hk).
    symmetry; assumption.
  - exact Hms.
Qed.

Lemma extract_i1_from_nested_decide
  (i i2 i1 : Z) (p : bool) (A : Prop) :
  (if decide (0 < i)
   then p = false /\ A /\ (if decide (2 + i2 <= i) then i1 = 0 else i1 = 1)
   else i1 = 1) ->
  (i1 = 0 \/ i1 = 1).

  intro H.

  - destruct H as (_ & _ & Hif).
    destruct (decide (2 + i2 <= i)) eqn:Hle.
    + left. exact Hif.

  - right. exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_comm :
  forall (m : addr -> Z) (p1 p2 : addr) (v1 v2 : Z) (q : addr),
    p1 <> p2 ->
    fun_updt (fun_updt m p1 v1) p2 v2 q =
    fun_updt (fun_updt m p2 v2) p1 v1 q.
Proof.
  intros m p1 p2 v1 v2 q Hneq.
  destruct (classic (q = p1)) as [Hq1|Hq1].
  - subst q.
    rewrite fun_updt_neq by (intro C; apply Hneq; symmetry; exact C).
    rewrite fun_updt_eq.
    rewrite fun_updt_eq.
    reflexivity.
  - destruct (classic (q = p2)) as [Hq2|Hq2].
    + subst q.
      rewrite fun_updt_eq.
      rewrite fun_updt_neq by (intro C; apply Hneq; exact C).
      rewrite fun_updt_eq.
      reflexivity.
    + repeat rewrite fun_updt_neq by congruence.
      reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma nested_if_yields_eq :
  forall (P Q : Prop) (A : Type) (x y z : A),
    (if decide P then (if decide Q then x else y) else z) = z ->
    decide P = false \/
    (decide P = true /\ decide Q = false /\ y = z) \/
    (decide P = true /\ decide Q = true /\ x = z).
Proof.
  intros P Q A x y z H.
  destruct (decide P) eqn:HP; simpl in H.
  - destruct (decide Q) eqn:HQ; simpl in H.
    + right; right. repeat split; auto.
    + right; left. repeat split; auto.
  - left; auto.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma upd_eq :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (m : A -> B) (k : A) (v : B),
    upd eq_dec m k v k = v.
Proof.
  intros A B eq_dec m k v.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (eq_dec k k) as [H|H]; [reflexivity|].
  exfalso; apply H; reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma upd_neq :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (m : A -> B) (k x : A) (v : B),
    x <> k ->
    upd eq_dec m k v x = m x.
Proof.
  intros A B eq_dec m k x v Hneq.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (eq_dec x k) as [Heq|Hne]; [|reflexivity].
  exfalso; apply Hneq; exact Heq.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_shadow
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma upd_shadow :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (m : A -> B) (k : A) (v1 v2 : B),
    upd eq_dec (upd eq_dec m k v1) k v2 = upd eq_dec m k v2.
Proof.
  intros A B eq_dec m k v1 v2.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro x.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (eq_dec x k); reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma upd_comm :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (m : A -> B) (k1 k2 : A) (v1 v2 : B),
    k1 <> k2 ->
    upd eq_dec (upd eq_dec m k1 v1) k2 v2 =
    upd eq_dec (upd eq_dec m k2 v2) k1 v1.
Proof.
  intros A B eq_dec m k1 k2 v1 v2 Hneq.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro x.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (eq_dec x k2) as [Hx2|Hx2];
  destruct (eq_dec x k1) as [Hx1|Hx1]; subst; try reflexivity;
  exfalso; apply Hneq; reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: wp_if_decide_extract_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma wp_if_decide_extract_eq
  (P : Prop) (a_4 t_3 : addr -> Z) (a_5 : addr) (a_8 : Z) (Hrw : Prop) :
  (if decide P then fun_updt a_4 a_5 a_8 = t_3 /\ Hrw else a_4 = t_3) ->
  (decide P = true -> fun_updt a_4 a_5 a_8 = t_3) /\
  (decide P = false -> a_4 = t_3).
Proof.
  intro H.
  split.
  - intro Hd.
    destruct (decide P) eqn:E; try discriminate.
    destruct H as [Heq _]. exact Heq.
  - intro Hd.
    destruct (decide P) eqn:E; try discriminate.
    exact H.
Qed.

  (t_3 = fun_updt a_4 a_5 a_8) \/ (t_3 = a_4).
Proof.
  intro H.
  destruct (decide P) eqn:E.
  - left. destruct H as [Heq _]. symmetry. exact Heq.
  - right. symmetry. exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: p_multisetadd_morph_mem
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma p_multisetadd_morph_mem :
  forall (m1 m2 t2 : addr -> Z) (a : addr) (n x : Z),
    m1 = m2 ->
    p_multisetadd m1 t2 a n x ->
    p_multisetadd m2 t2 a n x.

Lemma fun_updt_eq :

Lemma fun_updt_comm :
  forall (f : addr -> Z) (p q : addr) (vp vq : Z),
    p <> q ->

Proof.
  intros f p q vp vq Hpq.

  unfold fun_updt.

  destruct (addr_eq_dec r p) as [Hrp|Hrnp].
  - subst. exfalso. apply Hpq. reflexivity.
  - subst. reflexivity.
  - subst. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma upd_eq :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})

Lemma upd_neq :

         (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})
         (f : A -> B) (x y : A) (v : B),
    y <> x ->
    upd eq_dec f x v y = f y.
Proof.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_id

Lemma upd_id :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})
         (f : A -> B) (x : A),
    upd eq_dec f x (f x) = f.
Proof.
  intros A B eq_dec f x.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro y.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (eq_dec y x) as [->|Hne]; reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: upd_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma upd_comm :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})
         (f : A -> B) (x1 x2 : A) (v1 v2 : B),
    x1 <> x2 ->
    upd eq_dec (upd eq_dec f x1 v1) x2 v2 =
    upd eq_dec (upd eq_dec f x2 v2) x1 v1.
Proof.
  intros A B eq_dec f x1 x2 v1 v2 Hneq.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro y.
  unfold upd.
  destruct (eq_dec y x2) as [Hy2|Hy2].
  - subst y.
    (* left: update at x2 yields v2 *)
    (* right: since x2 <> x1, inner update at x1 does not affect x2 *)
    destruct (eq_dec x2 x1) as [H|H].
    + exfalso; apply Hneq; symmetry; exact H.
    + reflexivity.
  - destruct (eq_dec y x1) as [Hy1|Hy1].
    + subst y.
      (* left: since x1 <> x2, outer update at x2 does not affect x1 *)
      destruct (eq_dec x1 x2) as [H|H].
      * exfalso; apply Hneq; exact H.
      * reflexivity.
    + (* y is different from both x1 and x2: both sides reduce to f y *)
      reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: depends_only_on_update_outside
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma depends_only_on_update_outside :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall (u v : A), {u = v} + {u <> v})
         (S : A -> Prop) (P : (A -> B) -> Prop)
         (m : A -> B) (x : A) (v : B),
    depends_only_on S P ->
    (forall y, S y -> y <> x) ->
    P m ->
    P (upd eq_dec m x v).
Proof.
  intros A B eq_dec S P m x v Hdep Hout HPm.
  apply (Hdep m (upd eq_dec m x v)).
  - intros y HyS.
    rewrite upd_neq; auto.
  - exact HPm.
Qed.

Lemma if_decide_elim
  (P : Prop) (A B : Prop) :
  (if decide P then A else B) ->
  (P -> A) /\ (~ P -> B).
Proof.
  intro Hif.
  split.
  - intro HP.
    apply (proj2 (decide_spec P)) in HP.
    rewrite HP in Hif.
    exact Hif.
  - intro HnP.
    apply (proj2 (decide_false_iff P)) in HnP.
    rewrite HnP in Hif.
    exact Hif.
Qed.

Proof.
  intro H.
  pose proof (if_decide_elim P (fun_updt a4 a5 a8 = t3) (a4 = t3) H) as Hsplit.
  destruct Hsplit as [HP HnP].
  split.
  - intro HP'.
    specialize (HP HP').
    symmetry; exact HP.
  - intro HnP'.
    specialize (HnP HnP').
    symmetry; exact HnP.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_eq :
  forall (A B : Type) `{EqDec A} (f : A -> B) (x : A) (v : B),
    fun_updt f x v x = v.
Proof.
  intros A B Hdec f x v.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (eq_dec x x) as [E|N].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; apply N; reflexivity.
Qed.

    y <> x ->
    fun_updt f x v y = f y.
Proof.
  intros A B Hdec f x y v Hneq.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (eq_dec y x) as [E|N].
  - exfalso; apply Hneq; exact E.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_shadow
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_shadow :
  forall (A B : Type) `{EqDec A} (f : A -> B) (x : A) (v1 v2 : B),
    fun_updt (fun_updt f x v1) x v2 = fun_updt f x v2.
Proof.
  intros A B Hdec f x v1 v2.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro y.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (eq_dec y x); reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updt_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updt_comm :
  forall (A B : Type) `{EqDec A} (f : A -> B) (x1 x2 : A) (v1 v2 : B),
    x1 <> x2 ->
    fun_updt (fun_updt f x1 v1) x2 v2 =
    fun_updt (fun_updt f x2 v2) x1 v1.
Proof.
  intros A B Hdec f x1 x2 v1 v2 Hneq.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro y.
  unfold fun_updt.
  destruct (eq_dec y x2) as [E2|N2].
  - subst y.
    destruct (eq_dec x2 x1) as [E21|N21].
    + exfalso; apply Hneq; symmetry; exact E21.
    + reflexivity.
  - destruct (eq_dec y x1) as [E1|N1].
    + subst y.
      destruct (eq_dec x1 x2) as [E12|N12].
      * exfalso; apply Hneq; exact E12.
      * reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: two_updates_swap_pointwise
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma two_updates_swap_pointwise :
  forall (f : Z -> Z) (x y : Z) (vx vy : Z),
    x <> y ->
    let f' := fun_updt (fun_updt f x vy) y vx in
    f' x = vy /\ f' y = vx /\ (forall z, z <> x -> z <> y -> f' z = f z).
Proof.
  intros f x y vx vy Hxy f'.
  subst f'.
  split.
  - (* at x *)
    rewrite fun_updt_neq.
    + rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
    + exact Hxy.
  - split.
    + (* at y *)
      rewrite fun_updt_eq. reflexivity.
    + (* elsewhere *)
      intros z Hzx Hzy.
      rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hzy.
      rewrite fun_updt_neq by exact Hzx.
      reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma update_on_range_idempotent :
  forall (A : Type) (eqb : A -> A -> bool)

         (m1 m2 m3 : A -> Z) (base : A) (len : Z),
    update_on_range A eqb in_range (update_on_range A eqb in_range m1 m2 base len) m3 base len =

Proof.
  intros A eqb in_range m1 m2 m3 base len.

Qed.

  forall (m : addr -> Z) (p : addr) (v1 v2 : Z),

Lemma conj_if_decide_else
  (D K T E : Prop) :
  (K /\ (if decide D then T else E)) ->
  (~D -> E).
Proof.
  intros [_ Hif] HnD.
  assert (decide D = false) by (apply (proj2 (decide_false_iff D)); exact HnD).
  rewrite H in Hif. exact Hif.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: conj_if_decide_then
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma conj_if_decide_then
  (D K T E : Prop) :
  (K /\ (if decide D then T else E)) ->
  (D -> T).
Proof.
  intros [_ Hif] HD.
  assert (decide D = true) by (apply (proj2 (decide_true_iff D)); exact HD).
  rewrite H in Hif. exact Hif.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: if_decide2_split
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma if_decide2_split
  (C D P E R : Prop) :
  (if decide C then (if decide D then P else E) else R) ->
  (~C -> R) /\ (C -> ~D -> E) /\ (C -> D -> P).
Proof.
  intro H.
  split.
  - intro HnC.
    assert (decide C = false) by (apply (proj2 (decide_false_iff C)); exact HnC).
    rewrite H0 in H. exact H.
  - split.
    + intros HC HnD.
      assert (decide C = true) by (apply (proj2 (decide_true_iff C)); exact HC).
      rewrite H0 in H.
      assert (decide D = false) by (apply (proj2 (decide_false_iff D)); exact HnD).
      rewrite H1 in H. exact H.
    + intros HC HD.
      assert (decide C = true) by (apply (proj2 (decide_true_iff C)); exact HC).
      rewrite H0 in H.
      assert (decide D = true) by (apply (proj2 (decide_true_iff D)); exact HD).
      rewrite H1 in H. exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: p_lowerbound_shift_instantiate

Lemma p_lowerbound_shift_instantiate :
  forall (t : addr -> Z) (a : addr) (i2 i1 i3 i : Z),
    lowerbound_shift_law t a i3 i2 i1 i ->
    p_lowerbound_1' t (shift a i3) i2 i1 i ->
    p_lowerbound_1' t a (i2 + i3) (i1 + i3) i.
Proof.
  intros t a i2 i1 i3 i Hlaw Hpre.
  unfold lowerbound_shift_law in Hlaw.
  specialize (Hlaw Hpre).
  (* Just rewriting to match the common WP let-binding x := i1+i3. *)

  unfold lowerbound_shift_law in Hlaw.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: StrictLowerBoundShift_post_goal0
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma StrictLowerBoundShift_post_goal0 :
  forall (a : Z -> Z) (c d b : Z) (val : Z),
    StrictLowerBound (fun i => a (i + b)) c d val ->
    StrictLowerBound a (c + b) (d + b) val.
Proof.
  unfold StrictLowerBound.
  intros a c d b val H i Hi.
  assert (Hpre : val < (fun j => a (j + b)) (i - b)).
  { apply H.
    destruct Hi as [Hci Hid].
    split; lia. }
  simpl in Hpre.
  replace ((i - b) + b) with i in Hpre by lia.
  exact Hpre.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: p_strictlowerbound_shift_pointwise
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma p_strictlowerbound_shift_pointwise :
  forall (t : addr -> Z) (a : addr) (c d b val : Z),
    (forall i : Z, c <= i < d -> val < t@[shift a b]) ->
    (forall i : Z, c + b <= i < d + b -> val < t@[a]).
Proof.
  intros t a c d b val H i Hi.
  assert (Hi' : c <= i - b < d).
  { apply Z_interval_shift; exact Hi. }
  specialize (H (i - b) Hi').
  rewrite shift_read in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: p_strictlowerbound_shift_wp

Lemma p_strictlowerbound_shift_wp :
  forall (t : addr -> Z) (a : addr) (c d b val : Z),
    p_strictlowerbound_1' t (shift a b) c d val ->
    p_strictlowerbound_1' t a (c + b) (d + b) val.
Proof.
  intros t a c d b val H.
  apply (proj2 (p_strictlowerbound_unfold t a (c + b) (d + b) val)).
  apply p_strictlowerbound_shift_pointwise.
  apply (proj1 (p_strictlowerbound_unfold t (shift a b) c d val)).
  exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtZ_eq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtZ_eq :
  forall (B : Type) (f : Z -> B) (x : Z) (v : B),
    fun_updtZ f x v x = v.
Proof.
  intros B f x v; unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec x x) as [_|H]; [reflexivity|lia].
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtZ_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtZ_neq :
  forall (B : Type) (f : Z -> B) (x y : Z) (v : B),
    y <> x ->
    fun_updtZ f x v y = f y.
Proof.
  intros B f x y v Hneq; unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec y x) as [Heq|Hne]; [lia|reflexivity].
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtZ_comm
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtZ_comm :
  forall (B : Type) (f : Z -> B) (x y : Z) (vx vy : B),
    x <> y ->
    fun_updtZ (fun_updtZ f x vx) y vy =
    fun_updtZ (fun_updtZ f y vy) x vx.
Proof.
  intros B f x y vx vy Hxy.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro k.
  unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec k y) as [Hky|Hkny];
  destruct (Z.eq_dec k x) as [Hkx|Hknx]; subst; try reflexivity; try lia.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: fun_updtZ_shadow
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma fun_updtZ_shadow :
  forall (B : Type) (f : Z -> B) (x : Z) (v1 v2 : B),
    fun_updtZ (fun_updtZ f x v1) x v2 = fun_updtZ f x v2.
Proof.
  intros B f x v1 v2.
  apply functional_extensionality; intro k.
  unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec k x); reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: swap_updtZ_at_x
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma swap_updtZ_at_x :
  forall (B : Type) (f : Z -> B) (x y : Z),
    x <> y ->
    swap_updtZ f x y x = f y.
Proof.
  intros B f x y Hxy.
  unfold swap_updtZ.
  (* unfold the two updates at point x *)
  unfold fun_updtZ at 1.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec x y) as [H|H]; [lia|].
  unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec x x) as [_|Hxx]; [reflexivity|lia].
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: swap_updtZ_at_y
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma swap_updtZ_at_y :
  forall (B : Type) (f : Z -> B) (x y : Z),
    x <> y ->
    swap_updtZ f x y y = f x.
Proof.
  intros B f x y Hxy.
  unfold swap_updtZ.
  unfold fun_updtZ at 1.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec y y) as [_|Hyy]; [|lia].
  (* now reduce inner update at y, which is not x *)
  unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec y x) as [H|H]; [lia|].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: swap_updtZ_elsewhere
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma swap_updtZ_elsewhere :
  forall (B : Type) (f : Z -> B) (x y k : Z),
    k <> x ->
    k <> y ->
    swap_updtZ f x y k = f k.
Proof.
  intros B f x y k Hkx Hky.
  unfold swap_updtZ.
  unfold fun_updtZ at 1.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec k y) as [H|H]; [lia|].
  unfold fun_updtZ.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec k x) as [H'|H']; [lia|].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: wp_then_branch_implies_value
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma wp_then_branch_implies_value
  (t_1 : addr -> Z) (a_1 a a_3 a_2 : addr) (i x x_1 x_2 : Z) (a_4 : addr) :
  x = to_sint8 i ->
  x_1 = t_1 a ->
  x_2 = t_1 a_1 ->
  a_4 = shift a_2 (l_strlen t_1 a_2) ->
  decide (x = x_2) = true ->
  (if decide (x = x_2)
   then a_1 = a /\ (a_4 = a) = (x_1 = 0) /\ (addr_lt a a_4) = (~ x_1 = 0)
   else True) ->
  x = x_1.
Proof.
  intros _ Hx1 Hx2 _ Hd Hif.
  apply (if_decide_then_elim (x = x_2)
           (a_1 = a /\ (a_4 = a) = (x_1 = 0) /\ (addr_lt a a_4) = (~ x_1 = 0)))
    in Hif; try exact Hd.
  destruct Hif as [Ha1a _].
  (* Use x = x_2 from decide true, and rewrite x_2 and x_1 via t_1 and a_1=a. *)
  apply decide_true in Hd.
  subst x_1 x_2.
  rewrite Ha1a in Hd.
  exact Hd.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: no_x_in_prefix_implies_at_a4_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma no_x_in_prefix_implies_at_a4_neq :
  forall (t1 : addr -> Z) (a2 a a4 : addr) (x : Z),
    (forall a6 : addr, addr_lt a6 a -> addr_le a2 a6 -> x <> t1 a6) ->
    addr_lt a4 a ->
    addr_le a2 a4 ->
    t1 a4 <> x.
Proof.
  intros t1 a2 a a4 x Hno Hlt Hle.
  (* Instantiate the prefix property at a4. *)
  specialize (Hno a4 Hlt Hle).
  (* Hno : x <> t1 a4 *)
  intro Heq.
  apply Hno.
  symmetry; exact Heq.
Qed.

    addr_lt a4 a ->
    addr_le a2 a4 ->
    ~ t1 a4 = x.
Proof.
  intros t1 a2 a a4 x Hno Hlt Hle.
  specialize (Hno a4 Hlt Hle).
  (* Hno : ~ x = t1 a4 *)
  intro Heq.
  apply Hno.
  symmetry; exact Heq.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: no_x_in_prefix_with_eq_right

Lemma no_x_in_prefix_with_eq_right :
