    addr_lt a4 a1 ->
    a1 = a ->
    addr_le a2 a4 ->
    ~ t1 a4 = x.
Proof.
  intros t1 a2 a a1 a4 x Hno Hlt Ha1a Hle.
  apply (no_x_in_prefix_implies_not_eq_wp_shape t1 a2 a a4 x Hno).
  - subst. exact Hlt.
  - exact Hle.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: no_x_in_prefix_with_le_right
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma no_x_in_prefix_with_le_right :
  forall (t1 : addr -> Z) (a2 a a1 a4 : addr) (x : Z),
    (forall a6 : addr, addr_lt a6 a -> addr_le a2 a6 -> ~ x = t1 a6) ->
    addr_lt a4 a1 ->
    addr_le a1 a ->
    addr_le a2 a4 ->
    ~ t1 a4 = x.
Proof.
  intros t1 a2 a a1 a4 x Hno Hlt Hle1 Hle2.
  apply (no_x_in_prefix_implies_not_eq_wp_shape t1 a2 a a4 x Hno).
  - exact (addr_lt_le_trans _ _ _ Hlt Hle1).
  - exact Hle2.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: decide_cases
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma decide_cases :
  forall P (Q : Prop),
    (if decide P then Q else Q) -> Q.
Proof.
  intros P Q H.
  destruct (decide P); exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: if_decide_elim
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma if_decide_elim :
  forall (P : Prop) (Q R : Prop),
    (if decide P then Q else R) ->
    (P -> Q) /\ (~ P -> R).
Proof.
  intros P Q R H.
  destruct (decide P) eqn:Hd.
  - split.
    + intro HP. exact H.
    + intro HnP. exfalso. apply HnP. apply decide_true with (P := P). exact Hd.
  - split.
    + intro HP. exfalso. apply (decide_false P Hd). exact HP.
    + intro HnP. exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: if_decide_then
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma if_decide_then :
  forall (P : Prop) (Q R : Prop),
    P ->
    (if decide P then Q else R) ->
    Q.
Proof.
  intros P Q R HP Hif.
  destruct (if_decide_elim P Q R Hif) as [Hthen _].
  exact (Hthen HP).
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: if_decide_else
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma if_decide_else :
  forall (P : Prop) (Q R : Prop),
    ~ P ->
    (if decide P then Q else R) ->
    R.
Proof.
  intros P Q R HnP Hif.
  destruct (if_decide_elim P Q R Hif) as [_ Helse].
  exact (Helse HnP).
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: extract_a1_eq_a_from_then_branch

Lemma extract_a1_eq_a_from_then_branch :
  forall (x x2 : Z) (a1 a : addr) (R0 : Prop),
    (if decide (x = x2) then a1 = a /\ R0 else True) ->
    x = x2 ->
    a1 = a.
Proof.
  intros x x2 a1 a R0 Hif Heq.
  pose proof (if_decide_then (x = x2) (a1 = a /\ R0) True Heq Hif) as H.
  exact (proj1 H).
Qed.

Proof.
  intros x x2 Q0 R0 Hif Hneq.
  apply (if_decide_else (x = x2) Q0 R0).
  - exact Hneq.
  - exact Hif.
Qed.

  intros t1 a1 a Hle Hnul Hno.
  pose proof (l_strlen_characterization t1 a1 a Hle Hnul Hno) as Ha.

  rewrite offset_shift.
  lia.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: l_strlen_characterization
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Axiom l_strlen_characterization :
  forall (t1 : addr -> Z) (a1 a : addr),
    (* a is within the string range *)
    addr_le a1 a ->
    (* a is NUL *)
    t1 a = 0%Z ->
    (* no NUL between a1 (inclusive) and a (exclusive) *)
    (forall a2 : addr, addr_lt a2 a -> addr_le a1 a2 -> t1 a2 <> 0%Z) ->
    (* then a is exactly a1 shifted by strlen *)
    a = shift a1 (l_strlen t1 a1).

offline_helper_lemmas.name: not_forall_exists_not
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma not_forall_exists_not :
  forall (A : Type) (P : A -> Prop),
    ~ (forall x : A, P x) ->
    exists x : A, ~ P x.
Proof.
  intros A P H.
  (* Use classical logic: ¬∀x.P x  ->  ∃x.¬P x *)
  apply NNPP.
  intro Hnex.
  apply H.
  intro x.
  apply NNPP.
  intro Hpx.
  apply Hnex.
  exists x.
  exact Hpx.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: not_forall_range_not_to_exists_in_range
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma not_forall_range_not_to_exists_in_range :
  forall (n : Z) (Q : Z -> Prop),
    ~ (forall i : Z, 0 <= i -> i < n -> ~ Q i) ->
    exists i : Z, 0 <= i /\ i < n /\ Q i.
Proof.
  intros n Q H.
  pose (P := fun i : Z => (0 <= i -> i < n -> ~ Q i)).
  destruct (not_forall_exists_not Z P H) as [i Hi].
  exists i.
  assert (H0 : 0 <= i).
  { apply NNPP; intro H0n.
    apply Hi; intros Hle _.
    exfalso; apply H0n; exact Hle. }
  assert (H1 : i < n).
  { apply NNPP; intro H1n.
    apply Hi; intros _ Hlt.
    exfalso; apply H1n; exact Hlt. }
  assert (HQ : Q i).
  { apply NNPP; intro HQn.
    apply Hi; intros _ _.
    exact HQn. }
  tauto.
Qed.

    offset ct_pre <= offset ct <= offset ct_pre + len.
Proof.
  intros ct_pre ct len Hlo Hhi.
  split.
  - exact (proj1 (addr_le_def ct_pre ct) Hlo).
  - (* Avoid automation; just rewrite and use the hypothesis. *)
    pose proof (proj1 (addr_le_def ct (shift ct_pre len)) Hhi) as H.
    rewrite offset_shift in H.
    exact H.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros ct_pre ct len H.
  destruct H as [Hlo Hhi].
  split.
  - apply (proj2 (addr_le_def ct_pre ct)). exact Hlo.
  - apply (proj2 (addr_le_def ct (shift ct_pre len))).
    rewrite offset_shift.
    exact Hhi.
Qed.

Lemma outside_interval_implies_not_in_interval_test :
  forall lo hi a : Z,
    a < lo \/ hi < a ->
    (Z.leb lo a && Z.leb a hi)%bool = false.
Proof.
  intros lo hi a Hout.
  destruct Hout as [Hlt | Hgt].
  - apply andb_false_iff'. left.
    apply Z_leb_false_iff. lia.
  - apply andb_false_iff'. right.
    apply Z_leb_false_iff. lia.
Qed.

  forall lo hi a : Z,
    (Z.leb lo a && Z.leb a hi)%bool = true ->
    lo <= a <= hi.
Proof.
  intros lo hi a H.
  apply andb_true_iff' in H.
  destruct H as [H1 H2].
  apply Z_leb_true_iff in H1.
  apply Z_leb_true_iff in H2.
  lia.
Qed.

    (Z.leb lo a && Z.leb a hi)%bool <> true.
Proof.
  intros lo hi a Hout Hin.
  pose proof (outside_interval_implies_not_in_interval_test lo hi a Hout) as Hf.
  rewrite Hin in Hf.
  discriminate.
Qed.

  replace (srclen - 1 + 1) with srclen in Hhigh' by lia.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: addr_le_to_shift_succ
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma addr_le_to_shift_succ :
  forall (a : addr) (x : Z) (a1 : addr),
    addr_le a1 (shift a (x - 1)) ->
    addr_le (shift a1 1) (shift a x).
Proof.
  intros a x a1 Hle.
  eapply addr_le_trans.
  - eapply addr_le_shift_compat; eauto.
  - rewrite shift_add.
    replace ((x - 1) + 1) with x by lia.
    apply addr_le_refl.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma included_shift_succ_in_range :
  forall (a a1 : addr) (x : Z),
    0 < x ->
    addr_le a a1 ->
    addr_le a1 (shift a (x - 1)) ->
    included (shift a1 1) 1 (shift a 0) (1 + x).
Proof.
  intros a a1 x Hx Haa1 Ha1.
  eapply included_1_from_le_bounds.
  { apply one_plus_x_pos_of_x_pos; exact Hx. }
  { (* shift a 0 <= shift a1 1 *)
    eapply addr_le_trans.
    - (* shift a 0 <= shift a1 0 *)
      eapply addr_le_shift_compat; eauto.
    - (* shift a1 0 <= shift a1 1 *)
      apply addr_le_shift_mono; lia.
  }
  { (* shift a1 1 <= shift (shift a 0) ((1+x)-1) = shift a x *)
    rewrite len_minus_one_simpl.
    rewrite shift_add.
    replace (0 + x) with x by lia.
    apply addr_le_to_shift_succ; exact Ha1.
  }
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: wp_inner_implies_i_eq_1
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma wp_inner_implies_i_eq_1 :
  forall (i i2 i3 : Z)
         (d_eq : {i3 = i2} + {i3 <> i2})
         (d_lt : {i3 < i2} + {~ (i3 < i2)}),
    i3 <> i2 ->
    ~ (i3 < i2) ->
    (if d_eq
     then i = 0 /\ i3 = 0
     else if d_lt then i = -1 else i = 1) ->
    i = 1.
Proof.
  intros i i2 i3 d_eq d_lt Hneq Hnlt H.
  destruct d_eq as [Heq|Hneq'].
  - exfalso. apply Hneq. exact Heq.
  - simpl in H.
    destruct d_lt as [Hlt|Hnlt'].
    + exfalso. apply Hnlt. exact Hlt.
    + exact H.
Qed.

Proof.

  apply (wp_inner_implies_i_eq_1 i i2 i3 d_eq d_lt).
  - subst i2. lia.

  (* Use shift_0 to rewrite (shift a 0) into a, then monotonicity. *)
  assert (H : addr_le (shift a 0) (shift a k)).
  { apply addr_le_shift_mono. lia. }
  (* Now rewrite shift a 0 = a in H. *)
  rewrite shift_0 in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma inst_noeq_a_a3
  (t1 : addr -> Z) (a a1 a2 a3 : addr) :
  (forall a5 a4 : addr,
      addr_lt a5 a ->
      addr_le a1 a4 ->
      addr_le a2 a5 ->
      addr_lt a4 (shift a1 (l_strlen t1 a1)) ->
      t1 a5 <> t1 a4) ->
  addr_lt a a -> (* impossible premise, but kept to show the pattern; see next lemma *)
  addr_le a1 a3 ->
  addr_le a2 a ->
  addr_lt a3 (shift a1 (l_strlen t1 a1)) ->
  t1 a <> t1 a3.
Proof.
  intros H Hlt Hle1 Hle2 Hlt3.
  (* This lemma is intentionally not the one you will use directly, because a<a is false.
     It documents the instantiation pattern. *)
  specialize (H a a3 Hlt Hle1 Hle2 Hlt3).
  exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma wp_goal11_core
  (t1 : addr -> Z) (a a1 a2 a3 : addr) (x : Z) :
  x = t1 a ->
  (forall a5 a4 : addr,
      addr_lt a5 a ->
      addr_le a1 a4 ->
      addr_le a2 a5 ->
      addr_lt a4 (shift a1 (l_strlen t1 a1)) ->
      t1 a5 <> t1 a4) ->
  addr_lt a3 a ->

  t1 a3 <> x.
Proof.

  apply (neq_from_neq_t1 t1 a a3 x); [exact Hx|].

    1 <= l_strlen t1 cs ->
    addr_le cs sc1 /\ addr_le sc1 (shift cs (l_strlen t1 cs)).
Proof.
  intros t1 t cs sc1 Hvs Hsc1 Hlen.
  subst sc1.
  split.
  - (* cs <= cs+1 *)
    assert (H : addr_le (shift cs 0) (shift cs 1)).
    { apply shift_mono_le. lia. }
    rewrite shift_0 in H.
    exact H.
  - (* cs+1 <= cs+strlen *)

Qed.

Lemma p_valid_str_tail :
  forall (t : Z -> Z) (m : addr -> Z) (a : addr),
    p_valid_str t m a ->
    m a <> 0 ->
    p_valid_str t m (shift a 1).
Proof.
  intros t m a [n [Hn Hterm]] Hnz.
  assert (n <> 0) as Hn0.
  { intro H; subst n.
    rewrite shift_0 in Hterm.
    contradiction.
  }
  assert (1 <= n) by lia.
  exists (n - 1).
  split; [lia|].
  unfold shift.
  replace (a + 1 + (n - 1)) with (a + n) by lia.
  exact Hterm.
Qed.

    (let x := t1 a1 in x <> t1 a2) ->
    t1 a2 <> t1 a1.
Proof.
  intros t1 a1 a2 H.
  specialize (H).
  unfold not in *.
  intro Heq.
  (* Turn goal into the shape expected by H *)
  apply H.
  simpl.
  symmetry; exact Heq.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma wp_exists_witness_for_a4 :
  forall (t1 : addr -> Z) (a a1 a3 : addr),
    (forall a4 : addr,
        addr_lt a4 a1 ->
        addr_le a a4 ->
        exists a5 : addr,
          t1 a4 = t1 a5 /\
          addr_le a3 a5 /\
          addr_lt a5 (shift a3 (l_strlen t1 a3))) ->
    forall a4 : addr,
      addr_lt a4 a1 ->
      addr_le a a4 ->
      exists a5 : addr,
        t1 a4 = t1 a5 /\
        addr_le a3 a5 /\
        addr_lt a5 (shift a3 (l_strlen t1 a3)).
Proof.
  intros t1 a a1 a3 Hall a4 Hlt Hle.
  apply (Hall a4 Hlt Hle).
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: wp_witness_plus_absence_gives_neq
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma wp_witness_plus_absence_gives_neq :
  forall (t1 : addr -> Z) (a a1 a3 : addr) (x : Z),
    (forall a4 : addr,
        addr_lt a4 a1 ->
        addr_le a a4 ->
        exists a5 : addr,
          t1 a4 = t1 a5 /\
          addr_le a3 a5 /\
          addr_lt a5 (shift a3 (l_strlen t1 a3))) ->
    (forall a5 : addr,
        addr_le a3 a5 ->
        addr_lt a5 (shift a3 (l_strlen t1 a3)) ->
        t1 a5 <> x) ->
    forall a4 : addr,
      addr_lt a4 a1 ->
      addr_le a a4 ->
      t1 a4 <> x.
Proof.
  intros t1 a a1 a3 x Hex Habs a4 Hlt Hle.
  destruct (Hex a4 Hlt Hle) as [a5 [Heq [Hle5 Hlt5]]].
  eapply match_in_accept_range_implies_neq_if_x_absent; eauto.
Qed.

Proof.

Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.proof:

Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: inv_range_instantiates
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma inv_range_instantiates :
  forall (t1 : addr -> Z) (x : Z) (accept a a4 : addr),
    (forall a6 : addr, addr_lt a6 a -> addr_le accept a6 -> ~ x = t1 a6) ->
    addr_lt a4 a ->
    addr_le accept a4 ->
    ~ t1 a4 = x.
Proof.
  intros t1 x accept a a4 Hinv Hlt Hle.
  (* From invariant: ~ x = t1 a4, then flip sides. *)
  apply not_eq_sym_Z.
  apply Hinv; assumption.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma addr_le_shift_r (p q : addr) (k : Z) :

Proof.
  intro Hpq.
  split; intro H.
  - apply addr_le_offset in H.
    rewrite offset_shift in H.
    exact H.
  - apply offset_addr_le.
    rewrite offset_shift.

  - apply addr_le_offset; exact Hle.
  - apply addr_lt_offset; exact Hlt.
Qed.

Proof.

  pose proof (in_addr_range_offsets _ _ _ H) as Hoffs.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: offset_interval_to_addr_interval
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma offset_interval_to_addr_interval

offline_helper_lemmas.name: addr_lt_shift_to_offset_lt
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma addr_lt_shift_to_offset_lt :
  forall (a b : addr) (k : Z),
    addr_lt b (shift a k) ->
    offset b < offset a + k.
Proof.
  intros a b k Hlt.
  (* Convert to offsets, then rewrite the RHS using offset_shift. *)
  pose proof (addr_lt_offset _ _ Hlt) as H.
  (* H : offset b < offset (shift a k) *)
  rewrite (offset_shift a k) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: addr_le_shift_to_offset_le
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma addr_le_shift_to_offset_le :

    addr_le b (shift a k) ->
    offset b <= offset a + k.
Proof.
  intros a b k Hle.
  pose proof (addr_le_offset _ _ Hle) as H.
  (* H : offset b <= offset (shift a k) *)
  rewrite (offset_shift a k) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: addr_between_shift_interval_offsets

Lemma addr_between_shift_interval_offsets :
  forall (a3 a8 : addr) (len : Z),
    addr_le a3 a8 ->
    addr_lt a8 (shift a3 len) ->
    offset a3 <= offset a8 < offset a3 + len.
Proof.
  intros a3 a8 len Hle Hlt.
  split.
  - apply addr_le_offset; exact Hle.
  - (* Use the previous lemma to avoid fragile rewriting. *)
    apply (addr_lt_shift_to_offset_lt a3 a8 len); exact Hlt.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: specialize_wp_universal_to_a5
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma specialize_wp_universal_to_a5 :
  forall (a a1 a3 a5 a6 : addr) (t1 : addr -> Z),
    (forall a7 : addr,
        addr_lt a7 a1 ->
        addr_le a a7 ->
        exists a8 : addr,
          t1 a7 = t1 a8 /\ addr_le a3 a8 /\ addr_lt a8 a6) ->
    addr_lt a5 a1 ->
    addr_le a a5 ->
    exists a7 : addr,
      t1 a5 = t1 a7 /\ addr_le a3 a7 /\ addr_lt a7 a6.
Proof.
  intros a a1 a3 a5 a6 t1 Hall Hlt Hle.
  specialize (Hall a5 Hlt Hle) as Hex.
  destruct Hex as [a8 [Heq [Hle3 Hlt6]]].
  exists a8; repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: wp_witness_in_accept_range_offsets
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma wp_witness_in_accept_range_offsets :
  forall (a3 a7 : addr) (len : Z),
    addr_le a3 a7 ->
    addr_lt a7 (shift a3 len) ->
    exists off7 : Z,
      off7 = offset a7 /\
      offset a3 <= off7 < offset a3 + len.
Proof.
  intros a3 a7 len Hle Hlt.
  exists (offset a7).
  split; [reflexivity|].
  apply addr_between_shift_interval_offsets; assumption.
Qed.

offline_helper_lemmas.name: wp_goal_shape_bridge
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma wp_goal_shape_bridge :
  forall (a a1 a3 a5 : addr) (t1 : addr -> Z) (len : Z),
    addr_lt a5 a1 ->
    addr_le a a5 ->
    (forall a7 : addr,
        addr_lt a7 a1 ->
        addr_le a a7 ->
        exists a8 : addr,
          t1 a7 = t1 a8 /\ addr_le a3 a8 /\ addr_lt a8 (shift a3 len)) ->
    exists a8 : addr,

offline_helper_lemmas.name: wp_goal13_reduction
offline_helper_lemmas.proof:
Lemma wp_goal13_reduction
  (a a1 : addr) (i : Z) (t1 : addr -> Z) :
  (* shifted terminators *)
  t1 (shift a i) = 0 ->
  t1 (shift a1 i) = 0 ->
  (* nonzero before i, extracted from the second quantified hypothesis *)
  (forall i1 : Z,
      let x := t1 (shift a i1) in
      let x1 := t1 (shift a1 i1) in
      0 <= i1 -> i1 < i ->
      ~ x = 0 /\ ~ x1 = 0 /\ x1 = x) ->
  l_sysfs_strlen t1 a1 = l_sysfs_strlen t1 a.
Proof.
  intros Ha0 Hb0 Hnz.
  apply (l_sysfs_strlen_eq_of_first_null_same_index t1 a1 a i).
  - apply wp_first_null_at_from_shifted_zero.
    + exact Hb0.
    + apply wp_nonzero_from_quant_right with (a := a) (a1 := a1); exact Hnz.
  - apply wp_first_null_at_from_shifted_zero.
    + exact Ha0.
    + apply wp_nonzero_from_quant_left with (a := a) (a1 := a1); exact Hnz.
Qed.

    x <> 0 ->
    x = x1 ->
    t1 (shift a1 i) <> 0 /\ t1 (shift a1 i) = t1 (shift a i).
Proof.
  intros t1 a1 a i x x1 Hnz Heq.
  subst x x1.
  split; auto.
Qed.

    (let old_s1 := fun k => t1 (shift a1 k) in
     let old_s2 := fun k => t1 (shift a k) in
     old_s1 i <> 0 /\ old_s1 i = old_s2 i).
Proof.
  intros t1 a1 a i H.
  simpl.
  exact H.
Qed.

  intros remain pqi_len Hrem Hpqi Hpqi_pos Hpqi_le.
  assert (0 <= remain) as Hrem0 by (apply is_uint16_nonneg; exact Hrem).
  assert (0 <= pqi_len) as Hpqi0 by (apply is_uint16_nonneg; exact Hpqi).
  pose proof (variant_decrease_from_bounds remain pqi_len Hrem0 Hpqi_pos Hpqi_le)
    as Hdec.
  destruct Hdec as [Hnonneg Hlt].
  split.
  - exact Hnonneg.
  - split.
    + exact Hlt.
    + unfold is_uint16.
      pose proof (is_uint16_upper _ Hrem) as Hrem_up.
      lia.
Qed.

Lemma digit_range_from_loop_inv :
  forall (i_1 k : Z) (xk : Z),
    0 <= k ->
    k < i_1 ->
    (forall i_7 : Z, 0 <= i_7 -> i_7 < i_1 -> 48 <= (if Z.eq_dec i_7 k then xk else 0) /\
                                         (if Z.eq_dec i_7 k then xk else 0) <= 57) ->
    48 <= xk /\ xk <= 57.
Proof.
  intros i_1 k xk Hk0 Hklt Hinv.
  specialize (Hinv k Hk0 Hklt).
  destruct Hinv as [Hlo Hhi].
  destruct (Z.eq_dec k k) as [_|Hneq]; [|contradiction].
  exact (conj Hlo Hhi).
Qed.

Lemma digit_from_loop_invariant_at_2 :
  forall (addr : Type)
         (shift : addr -> Z -> addr)
         (t1 : addr -> Z)
         (a7 : addr)
         (x : Z)
         (i1 : Z),
    x = t1 (shift a7 4) ->
    14 <= i1 ->
    (forall i2 : Z,
        let x1 := t1 (shift a7 (2 + i2)) in
        0 <= i2 -> i2 < i1 -> 48 <= x1 <= 57) ->
    48 <= x <= 57.
Proof.
  intros addr shift t1 a7 x i1 Hx Hi1 Hinv.
  subst x.
  specialize (Hinv 2).
  simpl in Hinv.
  assert (0 <= 2) as H0 by lia.
  assert (2 < i1) as H1 by lia.
  specialize (Hinv H0 H1).
  replace (2 + 2) with 4 in Hinv by lia.
  exact Hinv.
Qed.
